配角们也很少乏味。菲利普亲王是一位（严厉的）父亲，他把查尔斯送进了戈登斯顿，那是一所以冷水淋浴和清晨长跑著称、令这个男孩深恶痛绝的苏格兰寄宿学校；而他本人则对自己的从属角色愤愤不平。1952年女王决定子女沿用温莎这个姓氏时，他抱怨说自己是全国唯一一个不能让孩子随父姓的男人，还把自己（比作）“一只该死的变形虫”。1960年双方达成妥协：没有王室头衔的后代如今姓蒙巴顿-温莎，这个（连字符）是对其先人迟来的致意。2019年，97岁的他在桑德林汉姆附近卷入一起（撞车事故），所驾驶的路虎翻倒；他连一点（擦伤）都没有，但几周后交出了驾照。他的小姨子玛格丽特公主是王室中的（放荡不羁者）。1955年，她抵住了与离过婚的战斗英雄彼得·汤森结婚的（诱惑），理由是教会关于婚姻的教导以及她对英联邦的责任。上世纪70年代，她与比她小17岁的园林设计师罗迪·卢埃林发生了一段（私情），部分是在加勒比海的马斯蒂克岛上进行的，她每年冬天都在那里晒出一身（古铜色肤色）、召集宾客，这令王室极为（难堪），也加速了她在1978年与斯诺登勋爵离婚。她对礼节的态度全凭自己方便：想无视时便（不屑一顾），不想无视时又坚持要求别人遵守。
查尔斯当了半个多世纪的王储，把这段时间都投入到了各项事业中。其中许多曾遭嘲笑。1986年，他承认自己会跟植物说话；几十年来，他因警告海洋中的塑料、热带地区的（森林砍伐）以及化学农业造成的土壤（退化）而被嘲为怪人，如今这些警告大多显得颇有先见之明。在他位于格洛斯特郡的海格罗夫庄园，公爵领地家庭农场于上世纪80年代中期转为有机经营：庄稼不用合成农药也能（成熟），牛群靠吃青草和三叶草（长膘），一位（牧人）照料着牛群，农场的田地和一座修复过的（谷仓）已成为展示有机耕作方法的场所。他热衷于推广堆肥，堆肥能把（腐烂的）蔬菜和园艺修剪物变成肥沃的土壤；他还养蜂，蜜蜂把从他的野花草甸采来的花蜜和（花粉）储存在整齐的蜡质巢房里，每个巢房的形状都近似一个规则（六边形）；他母亲去世时，王室养蜂人按照古老习俗去“告知蜜蜂”。他长期提倡（繁育）被超市冷落的老品种水果和蔬菜，在海格罗夫的林地花园里，一株（蕨类植物）生长在“树桩园”朝天的树根之间。为庆祝母亲的白金禧，“女王的绿色华盖”计划号召英国人植树，从由（橡子）长成的橡树到颤动的（山杨），种下了一百多万棵。就连他的阿斯顿·马丁，母亲送他的21岁生日礼物，烧的也是用多余的英国白葡萄酒和奶酪制作中剩下的乳清（发酵）制成的燃料。
他对建筑的看法给他招来了敌人。1984年，他对英国皇家建筑师学会说，国家美术馆的一项扩建方案看起来像“一位深受喜爱的优雅朋友脸上长出的一个巨大脓疮”，该设计随后被放弃。1987年，他说德国空军炸毁圣保罗大教堂周围的建筑时，“并没有用比瓦砾更难看的东西来取代它们”。在许多建筑师眼里，他是个（脾气古怪的老顽固），他的干预会使争论变得（粗鄙），还会吓跑开发商；然而，他所痛斥的许多战后（只讲实用的）塔楼后来都已被（拆除），这表明他并非全错。在1989年出版的书和拍摄的电视纪录片《英国愿景》中，他试图（构想）另一种选择：人性化尺度的街道、本地材料、（朴素的）立面和古典比例。自1993年起在他的土地上兴建的多切斯特扩展区庞德伯里便是成果；批评者嘲笑它是缺乏（精致）的乔治王时代风格（仿制品），尽管当地居民似乎很喜欢。他的基金会帮助有志成为（工匠）的人学习传统技艺，从抹灰、铺茅草屋顶到石作工艺；它还教一位（石匠）如何将石块表面（打毛），制成粗琢面；他的传统艺术学校以（几何学家）般的严谨教授伊斯兰及其他神圣图案。2009年，他私下写信给卡塔尔王室的一名成员，后者的房地产公司随即撤回了罗杰斯勋爵为伦敦切尔西兵营旧址设计的现代主义方案；罗杰斯勋爵称之为滥用权力，宪政纯粹主义者则认为这是对王室不介入规划纠纷这一规则的（违反）。
查尔斯一向难以把自己的意见藏在心里。他在1976年用海军退役金创办了王子信托基金，该基金称已帮助一百多万来自（贫困）地区的年轻人实现就业、接受培训或自主创业；对于其中那些最贫困的孩子，狄更斯或许会用（流浪儿）来形容。1997年他飞赴香港出席交接仪式，香港这块殖民地最初是1842年通过（割让）取得的；他在一本私人日记中写道，中国领导人看上去像“可怕的老蜡像”；2005年《星期日邮报》刊登这本日记后，他提起诉讼，并赢得了随后的（官司）。惯例会（责成）任何君主把这类想法藏在心里，而私人意见与公开中立之间的（脱节）本就是这份工作的一部分：国家元首必须不（受制于）任何党派，而且要让人看到这一点。自继位以来，他大体上做到了，不过2022年在希尔斯伯勒城堡，他在访客簿上签名时墨水漏到了手指上，这次文具（故障）引发了一阵被镜头拍下的脾气。他以节俭著称，穿着打了补丁的西装和穿了几十年的鞋子，这一习惯反映的是对浪费的厌恶，而不是（邋遢之人）的漫不经心。
许多王室盛典并不像看上去那么古老。戴维·坎纳丁等历史学家认为，英国君主制的礼仪大多是19世纪后期（精心铺陈）出来的，当时一个正在丧失政治权力的王座成了民族与帝国自豪感的焦点；仪式靠（逐渐累积）而成，每一次庆典和加冕都在前一次的基础上增添新的花样。维多利亚于1877年被宣布为印度女皇；1911年，乔治五世和玛丽王后亲临德里主持杜尔巴大典，与会的土邦王公们珠光宝气，这是对一个很快就不再需要它的次大陆的帝国权力（展示）。收拾残局的任务落在了菲利普亲王的舅舅、末代总督蒙巴顿勋爵身上，他在1947年主持了仓促的印巴（分治），随之而来的流血冲突造成数十万人死亡，也许多达一百万。1979年，他被爱尔兰共和军杀害：在爱尔兰海岸外，他的渔船上一枚炸弹（引爆），还炸死了两个男孩和一位老妇人。
国王还是另外14个国家的元首，从加拿大到图瓦卢，这种安排偶尔会惹出麻烦。1975年，参议院阻挠工党政府的预算案后，澳大利亚总督约翰·克尔爵士解散了高夫·惠特拉姆的政府，并（委任）反对党领袖马尔科姆·弗雷泽为看守总理。惠特拉姆站在议会大厦的台阶上以（洪亮的）声音回应：“我们大可以说‘上帝保佑女王’，因为没有什么能拯救总督了！”克尔与王宫之间的信件在一位历史学家经过漫长的法律斗争后于2020年公开，信件显示，女王的私人秘书事先曾与他讨论过保留权力，但没有讨论解散政府本身。澳大利亚为此（四分五裂）多年。1999年，澳大利亚人以55%对45%否决了成为共和国的提议，部分原因是君主派与主张直选总统的共和派结成了（联盟），否决了提交表决的方案；此后共和运动便一直分裂成不止一个（派系）。2024年查尔斯访问堪培拉时，原住民参议员莉迪娅·索普在他讲话时大声（插话）：“你不是我的国王！”并（谴责）殖民者的种族灭绝。
在加勒比地区，风向正在转变。2021年巴巴多斯成为共和国，查尔斯出席了仪式，这（终结）了该国与英国王位之间可追溯至17世纪的联系，它的先例可能会（鼓舞）其他国家。2022年威廉和凯瑟琳出访该地区时，遇到了要求就奴隶制伸张补偿正义的抗议者，两人站在敞篷路虎上的照片在许多人看来是殖民时代的倒退；牙买加总理告诉他们，他的国家正在“向前看”。此类诉求的（升级）可能会使加勒比地区的舆论（强硬）起来，牙买加已开始通过立法，在没有国王的情况下（重新调整）本国的宪政安排。2024年在萨摩亚举行的英联邦峰会上，各国领导人一致认为，是时候就奴隶制的遗留问题展开对话了，查尔斯也承认“我们谁都无法改变过去”。王室出访仍是君主制最主要的外交工具，行程要避开南亚的（季风）雨季和西太平洋的（台风）季节，但热情的欢迎并不能保证忠诚。
什么可能令君主制垮台？丑闻是最明显的威胁。许多英国人对安德鲁与已定罪性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦交往一事深感（厌恶），这留下了一个可能（玷污）整个家族的（污点）。国王剥夺弟弟的头衔，是一次痛苦的（剪除），砍掉一根病枝以保全整棵树；而安德鲁今年2月从温莎一座有30个房间的宅子搬到100多英里外的桑德林汉姆庄园，所需要的恐怕远不止一辆（家具搬运车）。然而，精简后的君主制分担工作的人手也更少了。法律对国王患病或出国时由国事顾问代行职务作了（规定），2022年议会把安妮公主和爱德华王子增补进名单，因为安德鲁和哈里已不能再被召来履职。无论哈里与父亲达成何种和解，很少有人指望他会（重新加入）在职王室成员的行列。
至少，王位继承看来是稳固的。2013年通过的一项法律取消了男性继承人优先以及继承人不得与天主教徒结婚的规定，这是对沿用了几个世纪的规则的一次（放宽），因此夏洛特公主在王位继承顺序中排在弟弟路易之前。王储威廉如今掌管着康沃尔公爵领地，这片约13万英亩的地产包括达特穆尔大部分（贫瘠的）（地带），他已承诺利用这片地产帮助解决无家可归问题；他与自圣安德鲁斯大学求学时代起便相伴的（伴侣）凯瑟琳，在王室成员受欢迎程度的民调中经常名列前茅。
反对君主制的理由，单凭纯粹的（逻辑推理）就很容易提出。世袭职位不合理、不平等，按照任何民主（标准）都站不住脚。施压团体“共和”反对世袭统治；批评者指责其言论构成（贬损），而查尔斯乘车前往加冕时，该团体支持者挥舞着写有“不是我的国王”的标语牌。然而，支持君主制的理由靠的是经验而非逻辑。拥护者认为，与许多民选总统相（比较），立宪君主一直花费不多、无害，偶尔还有用处：它是超越党派纷争的国家（凝聚力）之源，是对政客虚荣心的一种制约，也提醒人们，这个国家的最高职位不是可以争抢得来的。民调显示，多数英国人仍然更喜欢君主制，而不是民选的国家元首，尽管年轻人的支持要弱得多，而任何公关手段都无法永远（哄骗）心存怀疑的年轻选民。
王室权力三个世纪以来一直在（渐弱态势）；剩下的是影响力，而影响力取决于善意。那些以为单靠习惯就能（维系）王位的君主制拥护者，可能会让它（枯萎）成一件博物馆展品；那些指望查尔斯或威廉（赢得）伊丽莎白二世晚年享有的广泛敬重的人，则低估了她为此付出的努力。王室传记总是在两极之间摇摆：一边是把每位君主都奉为圣贤的歌功颂德，一边是把每位君主都描绘成（傻瓜）的讽刺挖苦；事实上，这份工作既不需要天才，也不需要愚蠢，只需要耐力、圆通，以及甘愿当众忍受无聊的意愿。国王和女王之所以能存续，不是因为他们非存在不可，而是因为到目前为止，足够多的臣民宁愿留着他们。这是一个不稳固的基础。但这也是现代君主制唯一曾经拥有过的基础。
text:
本批词根亮点：

• -sent 家族：consent（同意）/assent（赞成）/dissent（异议）/resent（怨恨）/presentiment（预感），全来自拉丁 sentire（感觉）

• testament：来自 testis（证人），遗嘱=最后的见证文件，testify/attest/protest 同根

• flaunt vs. flout：flaunt=炫耀，flout=藐视，两词发音相近常被混淆

• mint：铸币厂来自罗马朱诺神庙旁的 Moneta，money/monetary 同源

• emolument：来自"研磨"（emolere），磨粉的酬劳=工资，emollient（润肤剂）同根

• immanent vs. imminent vs. eminent：内在的/迫近的/杰出的，三词易混，词根完全不同

• wont：古英语"习惯"，注意不是 won't（will not 的缩写）

quiz.question: patrician ______
quiz.explanation: 贵族的, 贵族家庭. The patrician family owned vast estates. 贵族家庭拥有广阔的地产。 | patri->父亲，patrician->父老贵族（罗马元老院成员）=贵族的（cf. patriarch族长） || 文化联想：魏晋南北朝的“王谢世家”最适合帮助记忆 patrician，可以说 **a patrician family — “The Wang and Xie clans of the Eastern Jin are often remembered as patrician families with enormous social prestige.”**

quiz.question: _____ geometrician
quiz.explanation: 几何学家, 著名的几何学家. Euclid was a noted geometrician. 欧几里得是一位著名的几何学家。 | geo->土地，metr->测量，geometrician->测量土地的人=几何学家 || 文化联想：刘徽研究几何与测量的形象最适合帮助记忆 geometrician，可以说 **a noted geometrician — “Liu Hui can be remembered as a noted geometrician whose mathematical work included sophisticated reasoning about areas and volumes.”**

quiz.question: quotidian _______
quiz.explanation: 日常的, 日常例行公事. The quotidian routine grew tedious. 日常例行公事变得单调乏味。 | quot->每，di->天（拉丁），quotidian->每天的=日常的（cf. quota份额） || 文化联想：中文“柴米油盐的日常”最适合帮助记忆 quotidian，可以说 **a quotidian routine — “Buying breakfast, commuting, working, and preparing dinner make up the quotidian routine of city life.”**

quiz.question: plebeian _____
quiz.explanation: 平民的, 平民品味. Critics dismissed it as plebeian taste. 批评家将其视为平民品味而不予理会。 | plebs->平民（拉丁，相对贵族patrician），plebeian->平民的（cf. plebiscite公民投票） || 文化联想：旧式精英若把街头小吃看成“平民口味”，最适合帮助记忆 plebeian，可以说 **plebeian taste — “A snobbish diner might dismiss inexpensive street snacks as plebeian taste simply because ordinary people enjoy them.”**

quiz.question: ______ ruffian
quiz.explanation: 恶棍, 街头恶棍. The street ruffian terrorized local businesses. 街头恶棍恐吓当地商家。 | ruff->粗糙（古法语），ruffian->粗暴之人=恶棍（cf. rough粗糙的） || 文化联想：中文“地痞流氓”最适合帮助记忆 ruffian，可以说 **a street ruffian — “A bully who extorts shopkeepers in an old street may be described as a street ruffian—‘地痞流氓.’”**

quiz.question: stygian ________
quiz.explanation: 幽暗的, 幽暗的黑暗. The cave was filled with stygian darkness. 洞穴充满了幽暗的黑暗。 | Styx->冥河（希腊神话），stygian->冥河般的=极度黑暗阴沉的 || 文化联想：桂林或重庆深洞里伸手不见五指的黑暗最适合帮助记忆 stygian，可以说 **stygian darkness — “Deep inside an unlit karst cave, visitors may encounter stygian darkness where almost nothing is visible.”**

quiz.question: bohemian _________
quiz.explanation: 波希米亚式的, 波希米亚式的生活方式. The artist embraced a bohemian lifestyle. 艺术家接受了波希米亚式的生活方式。 | Bohemia->捷克地区（吉普赛人被误以为来自此地），bohemian->不拘世俗的自由生活者 || 文化联想：北京 798 艺术区里自由、不拘常规的艺术生活很适合帮助记忆 bohemian，可以说 **a bohemian lifestyle — “An independent artist living cheaply near studios and galleries may embrace a bohemian lifestyle centered on art rather than convention.”**

quiz.question: simian ________
quiz.explanation: 猿猴的, 猿猴特征. The creature had distinct simian features. 这种生物有明显的猿猴特征。 | simia->猴子（拉丁），simian->猿猴的（cf. simulate模仿=像猴子一样模仿） || 文化联想：川金丝猴或猕猴明显的猴类面部特征最适合帮助记忆 simian，可以说 **simian features — “A macaque has unmistakably simian features, including a projecting muzzle and highly expressive face.”**

quiz.question: draconian ________
quiz.explanation: 严厉的, 严厉的措施. The government imposed draconian measures. 政府实施了严厉的措施。 | Draco->公元前7世纪雅典立法者（制定极严苛法律），draconian->严酷无情的 || 文化联想：中文“严苛到近乎不留余地的措施”最适合帮助记忆 draconian，可以说 **draconian measures — “A school rule that punishes a tiny first offense with permanent expulsion would be regarded as draconian measures rather than proportionate discipline.”**

quiz.question: thespian ______
quiz.explanation: 戏剧的, 戏剧事业. She pursued a successful thespian career. 她追求成功的戏剧事业。 | Thespis->古希腊悲剧创始人，thespian->戏剧的/演员（cf. drama戏剧） || 文化联想：京剧演员从小学戏、登台几十年的经历最适合帮助记忆 thespian，可以说 **a thespian career — “A Peking-opera performer who spends decades acting on stage has pursued a long thespian career.”**

quiz.question: octogenarian ___
quiz.explanation: 八十岁老人, 八十岁老人. The octogenarian man remained remarkably active. 八十岁老人仍然非常活跃。 | octo->八，gen->十，octogenarian->八十多岁的人（cf. sexagenarian六十岁，septuagenarian七十岁） || 文化联想：中文“八旬老人”最适合帮助记忆 octogenarian，可以说 **an active octogenarian — “An eighty-five-year-old calligrapher who still teaches every week is an active octogenarian.”**

quiz.question: valetudinarian ______
quiz.explanation: 过分关心健康的人, 过分关心健康的习惯. His valetudinarian habits dominated his life. 他过分关心健康的习惯主导了他的生活。 | valetudo->健康状况（拉丁），valetudinarian->过分担忧自身健康的人 || 文化联想：中文“天天把脉、量血压、担心自己哪里有病”最适合帮助记忆 valetudinarian，可以说 **valetudinarian habits — “Someone who checks every minor bodily sensation and constantly worries about illness may develop valetudinarian habits.”**

quiz.question: agrarian ______
quiz.explanation: 土地的, 土地改革. The revolution demanded agrarian reform. 革命要求土地改革。 | agr->田地（拉丁ager），agrarian->土地/农业的（cf. agriculture农业，agronomy农学） || 文化联想：中国近现代历史中的土地制度改革最适合帮助记忆 agrarian，可以说 **agrarian reform — “A policy that redistributes farmland or changes rural landholding is a form of agrarian reform.”**

quiz.question: egalitarian _______
quiz.explanation: 平等主义的, 平等主义社会. The nation strived for an egalitarian society. 国家努力建立平等主义社会。 | egal->平等（法语égal），egalitarian->主张人人平等的（cf. equal平等） || 文化联想：“王侯将相宁有种乎”所表达的反等级精神很适合帮助记忆 egalitarian，可以说 **an egalitarian ideal — “The cry ‘Are kings and nobles born different from the rest?’ can be remembered as an egalitarian ideal challenging inherited status.”**

quiz.question: totalitarian ______
quiz.explanation: 极权主义的, 极权主义政权. The totalitarian regime suppressed dissent. 极权主义政权镇压异议。 | total->全部，totalitarian->控制全部的=极权主义的（cf. total全部） || 文化联想：totalitarian 是现代政治学概念，可用中国学生学习二十世纪世界史的课堂场景来记忆，可以说 **a totalitarian regime — “In a world-history class, students may study how a totalitarian regime attempts to control politics, media, and much of social life.”**

quiz.question: utilitarian ______
quiz.explanation: 实用主义的, 实用主义设计. The building featured stark utilitarian design. 建筑具有简朴的实用主义设计。 | util->使用（拉丁），utilitarian->以实用为目的的（cf. utility实用，utilize利用） || 文化联想：学生宿舍里只讲耐用、便宜和功能性的家具最适合帮助记忆 utilitarian，可以说 **utilitarian design — “A metal dormitory desk built for durability rather than beauty is an example of utilitarian design.”**

quiz.question: authoritarian ____
quiz.explanation: 专制的, 专制统治. Citizens resisted authoritarian rule. 公民抵制专制统治。 | author->权威，authoritarian->要求绝对服从权威的=专制的（cf. authority权威） || 文化联想：中文“家长式、一言堂管理”最适合帮助记忆 authoritarian，可以说 **an authoritarian style — “A household in which one elder makes every decision and tolerates no disagreement has an authoritarian style.”**

quiz.question: stentorian _____
quiz.explanation: 洪亮的, 洪亮的嗓音. The commander's stentorian voice echoed across the field. 指挥官洪亮的嗓音在战场上回响。 | Stentor->希腊神话中嗓音如50人合唱的传令官，stentorian->嗓音极其洪亮的 || 文化联想：龙舟比赛里领喊号子的人声音必须压过鼓声和水声，最适合帮助记忆 stentorian，可以说 **a stentorian voice — “A caller directing a dragon-boat crew may use a stentorian voice that carries above drums, splashing water, and cheering crowds.”**

quiz.question: pedestrian _____
quiz.explanation: 平淡无奇的, 平淡无奇的风格. The writer's pedestrian style bored readers. 作家平淡无奇的风格让读者感到厌烦。 | ped->脚，pedestrian->步行者/平淡无奇的（走路=最普通的=平庸） || 文化联想：中文“平铺直叙、毫无文采”最适合帮助记忆 pedestrian，可以说 **a pedestrian style — “An essay that merely lists facts without imagery or insight may have a pedestrian style—平淡得像流水账.”**

quiz.question: equestrian ______
quiz.explanation: 骑马的, 骑马雕像. An equestrian statue honors the general. 骑马雕像纪念将军。 | equ->马（拉丁equus），equestrian->骑马的（cf. equine马的，equerry马官） || 文化联想：秦始皇陵骑兵俑最适合帮助记忆 equestrian，可以说 **an equestrian figure — “A cavalry figure from the Terracotta Army presents an equestrian image of a soldier associated with a horse.”**

quiz.question: fustian ________
quiz.explanation: 浮夸的, 浮夸的言辞. The politician's fustian rhetoric fell flat. 政客浮夸的言辞不受欢迎。 | Fostat->埃及城市（产粗布），fustian->粗布/浮夸空洞的言辞 || 文化联想：中文“空话套话、辞藻浮夸”最适合帮助记忆 fustian，可以说 **fustian rhetoric — “A speech packed with grand slogans but little substance can become fustian rhetoric—满篇空话套话.”**

quiz.question: antediluvian _______
quiz.explanation: 古老的, 古老的信仰. His antediluvian beliefs seemed outdated. 他古老的信仰似乎已经过时。 | ante->之前，diluv->洪水（拉丁），antediluvian->大洪水之前的=极度古老的 || 文化联想：中文“老掉牙的观念”最适合帮助记忆 antediluvian，可以说 **antediluvian beliefs — “Treating a centuries-old social prejudice as unquestionable truth can make it look like an antediluvian belief—老掉牙的观念.”**

quiz.question: herdsman ___
quiz.explanation: 牧人, 牧人工作. The herdsman job requires patience and skill. 牧人工作需要耐心和技巧。 | herd->兽群，herdsman->管理兽群的人=牧人（cf. shepherd牧羊人） || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上放牧牛羊的牧民最适合帮助记忆 herdsman，可以说 **a skilled herdsman — “On the Inner Mongolian grasslands, a skilled herdsman guides livestock between grazing areas and water sources.”**

quiz.question: layman's _____
quiz.explanation: 外行, 外行的术语. Explain it in layman's terms. 用外行的术语解释它。 | lay->非专业的，layman->非专业人士=外行（cf. laity平信徒，lay reader非神职读经者） || 文化联想：中文“用大白话讲给外行听”最适合帮助记忆 layman，可以说 **in layman’s terms — “A doctor explaining a scan without technical jargon is describing it in layman’s terms—用大白话让普通人也听懂.”**

quiz.question: pan ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 严厉批评, 严厉批评电影. Critics were quick to pan the film. 批评家很快就严厉批评了这部电影。 | pan->锅/全部/批评（一词多义），pan a film->把电影批得一无是处 || 文化联想：豆瓣影评里一部烂片被批得体无完肤，最适合帮助记忆 pan，可以说 **pan a film — “Reviewers may pan a film when they think its script, acting, and pacing all fail badly.”**

quiz.question: deadpan _____
quiz.explanation: 面无表情的, 面无表情的幽默. His deadpan humor surprised audiences. 他面无表情的幽默让观众惊讶。 | dead->僵死的，pan->脸（俚语），deadpan->僵死的表情=面无表情的 || 文化联想：相声里的捧哏常面无表情地接一句冷幽默，最适合帮助记忆 deadpan，可以说 **deadpan humor — “A xiangsheng performer may use deadpan humor by delivering the funniest line with an entirely serious face.”**

quiz.question: ______ span
quiz.explanation: 跨度, 桥梁跨度. Engineers measured the bridge span. 工程师测量了桥梁跨度。 | span->伸展/跨越，attention span->注意力持续时间，bridge span->桥梁跨度 || 文化联想：赵州桥的主拱跨度最适合帮助记忆 span，可以说 **a bridge span — “Engineers studying the Zhaozhou Bridge can measure the bridge span from one support to the other.”**

quiz.question: diocesan ______
quiz.explanation: 教区的, 教区主教. The diocesan bishop visited parishes. 教区主教访问了教区。 | dia->穿过，oikos->家，diocesan->管理一片地区的=教区的（cf. diocese教区） || 文化联想：diocesan 是基督教教区用语，可用中国天主教会的教区主教来记忆，可以说 **a diocesan bishop — “In a Catholic diocese in China, a diocesan bishop oversees clergy and parishes within that church territory.”**

quiz.question: _______ artisan
quiz.explanation: 工匠, 熟练的工匠. The skilled artisan crafted fine furniture. 熟练的工匠制作精美的家具。 | art->技艺，artisan->有技艺的手工者=工匠（cf. artist艺术家，artificial人造的） || 文化联想：景德镇制瓷工匠最适合帮助记忆 artisan，可以说 **a skilled artisan — “A skilled artisan in Jingdezhen may specialize in shaping, glazing, painting, or firing porcelain.”**

quiz.question: tan _____
quiz.explanation: 褐色, 褐色. She preferred the tan color for the sofa. 她更喜欢沙发的褐色。 | tan->鞣制（用树皮鞣皮革变褐色），tan->晒成褐色/褐色 || 文化联想：未漂白亚麻、藤编和浅棕皮革的颜色很适合帮助记忆 tan，可以说 **a tan color — “A natural rattan chair often has a warm tan color that fits a simple Chinese-style interior.”**

quiz.question: _____ charlatan
quiz.explanation: 江湖骗子, 江湖骗子医生. The quack charlatan sold fake cures. 江湖骗子医生出售假药。 | ciarlare->喋喋不休（意大利语），charlatan->靠空话行骗的人=江湖骗子（cf. mountebank江湖骗子） || 文化联想：中文“江湖骗子卖祖传神药”最适合帮助记忆 charlatan，可以说 **a quack charlatan — “A man selling a fake ‘ancestral cure-all’ at a market may be exposed as a quack charlatan.”**

quiz.question: metropolitan ____
quiz.explanation: 大都市的, 大都市地区. The metropolitan area has millions of residents. 大都市地区有数百万居民。 | metro->母亲，polis->城邦，metropolitan->母城的=大都市的（cf. metropolis大都市） || 文化联想：上海及周边连成一体的大城市区域最适合帮助记忆 metropolitan，可以说 **a metropolitan area — “Shanghai and its tightly connected urban surroundings form a vast metropolitan area with millions of residents.”**

quiz.question: spartan _________
quiz.explanation: 简朴的, 简朴的生活方式. The monk led a spartan lifestyle. 修道士过着简朴的生活方式。 | Sparta->古希腊城邦（以艰苦训练闻名），spartan->简朴刻苦的 || 文化联想：中文“苦行僧般的简朴生活”可以帮助记忆 spartan，可以说 **a spartan lifestyle — “A monk who owns almost nothing and lives with only basic necessities follows a spartan lifestyle.”**

quiz.question: gargantuan ________
quiz.explanation: 巨大的, 巨大的胃口. The athlete had a gargantuan appetite. 运动员有巨大的胃口。 | Gargantua->拉伯雷小说中的巨人（胃口极大），gargantuan->巨大无比的 || 文化联想：春节年夜饭摆满整张大圆桌的巨大食量联想最适合帮助记忆 gargantuan，可以说 **a gargantuan appetite — “After a day of hard physical work, someone who seems able to finish half a New Year’s banquet may appear to have a gargantuan appetite.”**

quiz.question: wan _____
quiz.explanation: 苍白的, 苍白的微笑. She managed only a wan smile. 她只能勉强露出苍白的微笑。 | wan->暗淡（古英语wann），wan->面色苍白虚弱的（cf. wane减弱，月亮的亏） || 文化联想：久病初愈的人勉强露出苍白微笑最适合帮助记忆 wan，可以说 **a wan smile — “After several days of illness, a patient may manage only a wan smile when family members visit.”**

quiz.question: sadden ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使悲伤, 使人群悲伤. The tragic news would sadden the crowd. 悲惨的消息会使人群悲伤。 | sad->悲伤，sadden->使某人悲伤（-en使动后缀） || 文化联想：重大灾难遇难者名单公布后令人群悲伤的场景最适合帮助记忆 sadden，可以说 **sadden the crowd — “News that several rescuers had died could sadden the crowd gathered outside the hospital.”**

quiz.question: unbidden _____
quiz.explanation: 未经邀请的, 不由自主的眼泪. Unbidden tears filled her eyes. 不由自主的眼泪充满了她的眼睛。 | un->否定，bid->邀请/命令，unbidden->未被召唤就来的=不由自主的 || 文化联想：清明想起逝去亲人时眼泪自己涌出来，最适合帮助记忆 unbidden，可以说 **unbidden tears — “While sweeping a family grave at Qingming, memories may bring unbidden tears to someone’s eyes.”**

quiz.question: embolden __________
quiz.explanation: 使大胆, 使支持者大胆. The victory would embolden supporters. 胜利会使支持者更加大胆。 | em->使，bold->大胆，embolden->使大胆（-en使动后缀） || 文化联想：一场爆冷胜利会让原本胆怯的球队更有底气，最适合帮助记忆 embolden，可以说 **embolden the team — “An unexpected victory over a stronger opponent can embolden the team before the next match.”**

quiz.question: beholden __
quiz.explanation: 感恩的, 感恩于. He felt beholden to his mentor. 他对他的导师感恩。 | be->被，hold->持有，beholden->被人恩惠所持有的=感恩有义务的 || 文化联想：“滴水之恩，涌泉相报”最适合帮助记忆 beholden，可以说 **feel beholden to someone — “A student whose mentor provided crucial help may feel beholden to that mentor—‘滴水之恩，涌泉相报.’”**

quiz.question: harden ________
quiz.explanation: 变硬, 使态度变硬. Experience can harden attitude. 经验会使态度变硬。 | hard->坚硬，harden->使变硬（-en使动后缀，cf. soften使软化） || 文化联想：中文“吃过一次亏以后心就硬了”最适合帮助记忆 harden，可以说 **harden one’s attitude — “Repeated betrayal can harden a person’s attitude and make trust much more difficult.”**

quiz.question: ______ warden
quiz.explanation: 监狱长, 监狱长. The prison warden enforced strict rules. 监狱长执行严格的规则。 | ward->守护（古日耳曼），warden->守护者=看守/监狱长（cf. ward病房，guardian监护人） || 文化联想：现代监狱里的监狱长最适合帮助记忆 warden，可以说 **a prison warden — “A prison warden is responsible for the administration, security, and daily operation of a correctional facility.”**

quiz.question: _____ sheen
quiz.explanation: 光泽, 丝般光泽. Her hair had a beautiful silky sheen. 她的头发有美丽的丝般光泽。 | sheen->光亮（古英语sciene->美丽），sheen->柔和的光泽（cf. shine照耀） || 文化联想：苏州丝绸柔和反光的表面最适合帮助记忆 sheen，可以说 **a silky sheen — “Fine Suzhou silk can have a soft, silky sheen that changes subtly as the fabric moves.”**

quiz.question: pathogen ________
quiz.explanation: 病原体, 病原体接触. Healthcare workers risk pathogen exposure. 医护人员面临病原体接触风险。 | patho->疾病，gen->产生，pathogen->产生疾病的东西=病原体（cf. pathology病理学） || 文化联想：医院感染控制最适合帮助记忆 pathogen，可以说 **pathogen exposure — “Doctors and nurses use masks, gloves, and careful hygiene to reduce pathogen exposure in clinical settings.”**

quiz.question: _____ carcinogen
quiz.explanation: 致癌物, 已知的致癌物. Asbestos is a known carcinogen. 石棉是一种已知的致癌物。 | carcin->癌症（希腊karkinos->螃蟹），gen->产生，carcinogen->致癌物（cf. carcinoma癌） || 文化联想：中国公共卫生宣传中常把石棉、烟草烟雾等列作致癌风险，最适合帮助记忆 carcinogen，可以说 **a known carcinogen — “Asbestos is a known carcinogen, so old building materials containing it require careful handling.”**

quiz.question: roughen ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 使粗糙, 使表面粗糙. Sandpaper will roughen the surface. 砂纸会使表面粗糙。 | rough->粗糙，roughen->使粗糙（-en使动后缀，cf. smoothen使光滑） || 文化联想：传统木工为了让胶或涂层更容易附着，有时会先把表面处理得更粗，最适合帮助记忆 roughen，可以说 **roughen the surface — “A carpenter may lightly roughen the surface of wood before applying certain finishes or adhesives.”**

quiz.question: ______ hyphen
quiz.explanation: 连字符, 插入连字符. Insert hyphen between compound words. 在复合词之间插入连字符。 | hyph->在下（希腊hypo），hen->一，hyphen->连在一起的符号=连字符 || 文化联想：中国学生写英文复合词时常需要判断是否加连字符，最适合帮助记忆 hyphen，可以说 **insert a hyphen — “An English teacher may ask a Chinese student to insert a hyphen into a compound expression when standard spelling requires one.”**

quiz.question: _____ lien
quiz.explanation: 留置权, 法律留置权. The bank placed a legal lien on the property. 银行对财产设置了法律留置权。 | lien->绑定（法语，来自拉丁ligare->绑），lien->对财产的法律约束=留置权（cf. liable有责任的） || 文化联想：lien 是英美财产法常见词，可用中国买家阅读英文房产合同的场景来记忆，可以说 **a legal lien — “A Chinese buyer reading an English-language property contract may encounter a legal lien giving a creditor a claim against the property.”**

quiz.question: _____ mien
quiz.explanation: 风度, 高贵的风度. The ambassador had a noble mien. 大使有高贵的风度。 | mien->外貌举止（法语mine），mien->一个人的仪态风度（cf. demeanor举止） || 文化联想：梅兰芳登台时端庄从容的仪态最适合帮助记忆 mien，可以说 **a noble mien — “In photographs and stage portraits, Mei Lanfang often appears with a calm, noble mien suited to the characters he portrayed.”**

quiz.question: ______ ___'_ ken
quiz.explanation: 知识范围, 超出某人的知识范围. The concept was beyond one's ken. 这个概念超出了某人的知识范围。 | ken->认识/视野（苏格兰/古英语），beyond one's ken->超出理解范围（cf. know知道，同源） || 文化联想：中文“超出我的认知范围”最适合帮助记忆 ken，可以说 **beyond one’s ken — “An advanced proof in higher mathematics may be beyond one’s ken—也就是‘超出我的认知范围.’”**

quiz.question: liken __ ____
quiz.explanation: 比作, 比作黄金. Poets liken to gold her flowing hair. 诗人把她飘逸的头发比作黄金。 | like->相似，liken->比作=将…比喻为（cf. likewise同样地，likewise=以相似方式） || 文化联想：李白把月亮写成“白玉盘”的画面最适合帮助记忆 liken，可以说 **liken the moon to a jade plate — “A poet may liken the moon to a jade plate, echoing a famous image from classical Chinese poetry.”**

quiz.question: betoken ______
quiz.explanation: 预示, 预示变化. Dark clouds betoken change in weather. 乌云预示天气变化。 | be->使，token->标志，betoken->作为标志=预示（cf. token象征，by the same token同理） || 文化联想：“一叶知秋”最适合帮助记忆 betoken，可以说 **betoken a change — “A single yellow leaf can betoken a change of season—正所谓‘一叶知秋.’”**

quiz.question: hearken __ ______
quiz.explanation: 倾听, 倾听建议. Wise people hearken to advice. 聪明人倾听建议。 | hear->听，hearken->专心倾听（比listen更文学化，cf. hark!听！） || 文化联想：中文“听人劝，吃饱饭”最适合帮助记忆 hearken，可以说 **hearken to advice — “Someone who remembers ‘听人劝，吃饱饭’ is more willing to hearken to advice from experienced people.”**

quiz.question: pollen _____
quiz.explanation: 花粉, 花粉计数. Allergy sufferers check daily pollen count. 过敏症患者每天检查花粉计数。 | poll->细粉（拉丁pollen->细面粉），pollen->花粉（cf. poll民意调查，pollenate授粉） || 文化联想：北京春季过敏人群会关注每日花粉指数，最适合帮助记忆 pollen，可以说 **the pollen count — “During spring allergy season, residents may check the daily pollen count before spending hours outdoors.”**

quiz.question: ___ specimen
quiz.explanation: 样本, 实验室样本. Scientists examined the lab specimen carefully. 科学家仔细检查了实验室样本。 | spec->看，specimen->供查看的样品=样本（cf. inspect检查，spectacle奇观） || 文化联想：中药材标本馆里保存的一份植物样本最适合帮助记忆 specimen，可以说 **a botanical specimen — “A medicinal-plant museum may preserve a botanical specimen so students can study the plant’s leaves, stems, and flowers.”**

quiz.question: ______ cognomen
quiz.explanation: 姓氏, 家族姓氏. The family cognomen dated back centuries. 家族姓氏可以追溯到几个世纪前。 | co->共同，gnomen->名字（拉丁nomen），cognomen->共同的名字=家族姓氏（罗马人的第三个名字） || 文化联想：cognomen 是古罗马姓名制度概念，可用中国学生与中文“字、号”作比较但不等同来记忆，可以说 **a Roman cognomen — “A Chinese classics student studying Rome may compare a Roman cognomen with Chinese naming customs while remembering that a cognomen is not the same as a 字 or 号.”**

quiz.question: ________ acumen
quiz.explanation: 敏锐, 商业敏锐. Her business acumen impressed investors. 她的商业敏锐给投资者留下了深刻印象。 | acum->尖锐（拉丁acus->针），acumen->思维尖锐=敏锐（cf. acute急性的/尖锐的） || 文化联想：徽商、晋商善于判断市场和经营机会的形象最适合帮助记忆 acumen，可以说 **business acumen — “A merchant who reads demand accurately and manages risk well demonstrates strong business acumen.”**

quiz.question: lumen ______
quiz.explanation: 流明, 流明输出. The bulb provides high lumen output. 灯泡提供高流明输出。 | lumen->光（拉丁），lumen->光通量单位=流明（cf. illuminate照亮，luminous发光的） || 文化联想：买 LED 灯泡时包装上标注多少流明最适合帮助记忆 lumen，可以说 **lumen output — “A homeowner comparing LED bulbs may check the lumen output to judge how much visible light each bulb produces.”**

quiz.question: linen _____
quiz.explanation: 亚麻布, 亚麻布. The tablecloth was made of fine linen cloth. 桌布由精细的亚麻布制成。 | linum->亚麻（拉丁），linen->亚麻织成的布（cf. line线，linoleum油毡，均来自亚麻） || 文化联想：夏季亚麻衬衫和亚麻桌布最适合帮助记忆 linen，可以说 **linen cloth — “A lightweight summer shirt made from linen cloth can feel cooler and more breathable in humid weather.”**

quiz.question: ___ pen
quiz.explanation: 笔, 墨水笔. He signed the document with an ink pen. 他用墨水笔签署了文件。 | pen->羽毛/笔（拉丁penna->羽毛，古人用羽毛蘸墨写字），pen->钢笔/围栏（一词两义） || 文化联想：中文学生用钢笔写作业、签名的场景最适合帮助记忆 pen，可以说 **an ink pen — “A student may use an ink pen to sign a form or copy a passage neatly into a notebook.”**

quiz.question: misshapen _____
quiz.explanation: 畸形的, 畸形的水果. The farmer discarded misshapen fruit. 农民丢弃了畸形的水果。 | mis->错误，shape->形状，misshapen->形状出错的=畸形的 || 文化联想：果园里长歪了的苹果或梨最适合帮助记忆 misshapen，可以说 **misshapen fruit — “A farmer may sell misshapen fruit cheaply even though its unusual shape does not necessarily affect the taste.”**

quiz.question: ripen _____
quiz.explanation: 使成熟, 使水果成熟. Leave the bananas to ripen fruit naturally. 让香蕉自然成熟。 | ripe->成熟，ripen->使成熟（-en使动后缀，cf. harden使变硬） || 文化联想：秋天树上的柿子由青变红、逐渐成熟最适合帮助记忆 ripen，可以说 **ripen naturally — “Persimmons left on the tree can ripen naturally as autumn temperatures fall.”**

quiz.question: aspen _____
quiz.explanation: 白杨, 白杨树林. The aspen grove shimmered in the breeze. 白杨树林在微风中闪烁。 | aspen->白杨（古英语æspe），叶子随风颤抖，aspen->白杨（cf. Aspen科罗拉多滑雪小镇） || 文化联想：新疆或川西山地随风颤动的山杨林最适合帮助记忆 aspen，可以说 **an aspen grove — “In a mountain valley, an aspen grove may shimmer as thousands of pale leaves tremble in the wind.”**

quiz.question: barren ____
quiz.explanation: 贫瘠的, 贫瘠的土地. The desert was barren land without water. 沙漠是没有水的贫瘠土地。 | barren->无产出的（古法语），barren->不育的/贫瘠的（cf. baron男爵，同音但不同义） || 文化联想：西北戈壁缺水少植被的景象最适合帮助记忆 barren，可以说 **barren land — “Parts of the Gobi can appear as barren land where water is scarce and vegetation is sparse.”**

quiz.question: loosen ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 松开, 松开螺丝. Use a screwdriver to loosen the screw. 用螺丝刀松开螺丝。 | loose->松，loosen->使变松（-en使动后缀，cf. tighten使拉紧） || 文化联想：家里维修柜门时先把过紧的螺丝稍微松开最适合帮助记忆 loosen，可以说 **loosen the screw — “A homeowner may loosen the screw slightly before realigning a crooked cabinet hinge.”**

quiz.question: coarsen ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使粗糙, 使纹理粗糙. Grinding will coarsen the grain. 研磨会使纹理粗糙。 | coarse->粗糙，coarsen->使变粗糙（-en使动后缀，cf. roughen使粗糙） || 文化联想：传统粗陶表面如果刻意减少打磨，就会显得更粗粝，最适合帮助记忆 coarsen，可以说 **coarsen the texture — “A potter may deliberately coarsen the texture of a clay vessel to create a more rustic surface.”**

quiz.question: enlighten ____
quiz.explanation: 启发, 启发思想. Education should enlighten mind. 教育应该启发思想。 | en->使，light->光，enlighten->使进入光明=启发（cf. Enlightenment启蒙运动） || 文化联想：“开卷有益”最适合帮助记忆 enlighten，可以说 **enlighten the mind — “Reading history and philosophy can enlighten the mind—正如‘开卷有益’所强调的那样.”**

quiz.question: molten ____
quiz.explanation: 熔化的, 熔化的熔岩. Molten lava flowed down the volcano. 熔化的熔岩从火山流下。 | melt->熔化，molten->熔化状态的（过去分词形容词，cf. frozen冻结的，swollen肿胀的） || 文化联想：龙泉宝剑或传统铁器锻造中炽热熔融金属最适合帮助记忆 molten，可以说 **molten metal — “In a foundry, molten metal glows intensely before it is poured into a mold or worked into a finished object.”**

quiz.question: ____ dishearten
quiz.explanation: 使沮丧, 消息使人沮丧. Bad news dishearten the team. 坏消息使团队沮丧。 | dis->去除，heart->心，dishearten->使失去心气=使沮丧（cf. encourage->en+courage鼓励） || 文化联想：落榜消息让考生一下泄气的场景最适合帮助记忆 dishearten，可以说 **dishearten a student — “An unexpected exam failure can dishearten a student, especially after months of preparation.”**

quiz.question: fasten ________
quiz.explanation: 系紧, 系紧安全带. Please fasten seatbelt during flight. 请在飞行期间系紧安全带。 | fast->固定/紧（古义），fasten->使固定=系紧（cf. steadfast坚定不移） || 文化联想：中国驾校反复提醒“上车先系安全带”，最适合帮助记忆 fasten，可以说 **fasten a seatbelt — “A driving instructor will remind every learner to fasten a seatbelt before starting the car.”**

quiz.question: unfasten ____
quiz.explanation: 解开, 解开腰带. She moved to unfasten belt after the meal. 她在饭后准备解开腰带。 | un->反向，fasten->系紧，unfasten->解开（cf. unbutton解扣，undo解开） || 文化联想：穿汉服或长袍回家后先解开腰带最适合帮助记忆 unfasten，可以说 **unfasten a belt — “After a formal ceremony, someone wearing traditional-style dress may unfasten a belt before changing clothes.”**

quiz.question: chasten ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 惩戒, 惩戒精神. Hardship can chasten the spirit. 困难可以惩戒精神。 | chaste->纯洁，chasten->通过惩戒使纯洁=磨砺惩戒（cf. chastise惩罚，chastity贞洁） || 文化联想：中文“吃一堑，长一智”最适合帮助记忆 chasten，可以说 **chasten one’s pride — “A painful defeat can chasten one’s pride and make future decisions more careful—‘吃一堑，长一智.’”**

quiz.question: fatten ______
quiz.explanation: 使肥胖, 使牛肥胖. Farmers fatten cattle before market. 农民在上市前使牛肥胖。 | fat->脂肪/肥，fatten->使变肥（-en使动后缀，cf. flatten使平坦） || 文化联想：过去农村春节前把猪养肥的场景最适合帮助记忆 fatten，可以说 **fatten pigs — “A farming household might fatten pigs for months before selling or slaughtering them near the New Year.”**

quiz.question: hardbitten _______
quiz.explanation: 坚强的, 坚强的老兵. The hardbitten veteran had seen many battles. 坚强的老兵经历过许多战斗。 | hard->艰难，bitten->被咬过的，hardbitten->被艰难咬过的=久经磨砺的 || 文化联想：在边疆或艰苦环境里多年摸爬滚打的老兵最适合帮助记忆 hardbitten，可以说 **a hardbitten veteran — “Years of difficult service in harsh conditions can turn a soldier into a hardbitten veteran who is not easily shocked.”**

quiz.question: rotten _____
quiz.explanation: 腐烂的, 腐烂的水果. The smell of rotten fruit filled the market. 腐烂水果的气味充满了市场。 | rot->腐烂，rotten->腐烂的（cf. rotten borough腐败选区） || 文化联想：菜市场里烂掉发软的桃子最适合帮助记忆 rotten，可以说 **rotten fruit — “A vendor removes rotten fruit quickly so that mold and decay do not spread to the rest of the basket.”**

quiz.question: leaven ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使发酵, 使面团发酵. Yeast will leaven the dough. 酵母会使面团发酵。 | leaven->发酵剂（拉丁levare->举起），leaven->用酵母使膨胀/注入活力（cf. levity轻浮） || 文化联想：蒸馒头前用酵母让面团发起来，最适合帮助记忆 leaven，可以说 **leaven the dough — “When making steamed buns, yeast helps leaven the dough so that it becomes light and airy.”**

quiz.question: ____ haven
quiz.explanation: 避难所, 安全避难所. The embassy offered a safe haven. 大使馆提供了安全避难所。 | haven->港口/庇护（古英语hæfen），safe haven->安全港湾=避难所（cf. harbor港口） || 文化联想：中文“避风港”几乎就是 haven 最直接的联想，可以说 **a safe haven — “A sheltered harbor can serve as a safe haven for fishing boats when a storm approaches.”**

quiz.question: _______ maven
quiz.explanation: 专家, 时尚专家. She's recognized as a fashion maven. 她被认为是时尚专家。 | maven->内行（意第绪语meyvn->理解者），maven->某领域专家（cf. connoisseur鉴赏家） || 文化联想：中文“行家里手”最适合帮助记忆 maven，可以说 **a tea maven — “A tea maven can often identify the origin and processing style of a tea from its aroma, leaves, and taste.”**

quiz.question: craven _________
quiz.explanation: 懦弱的, 懦弱的投降. The general condemned the craven surrender. 将军谴责懦弱的投降。 | crav->请求（古法语），craven->请求饶命的=懦弱的（cf. cowardly懦弱的） || 文化联想：中文“贪生怕死、临阵退缩”最适合帮助记忆 craven，可以说 **a craven surrender — “Abandoning everyone else at the first sign of danger may be condemned as a craven surrender—‘贪生怕死.’”**

quiz.question: enliven ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使活跃, 使聚会活跃. Music helped enliven the party. 音乐帮助使聚会活跃起来。 | en->使，live->生机，enliven->使充满生机=使活跃（cf. lively生气勃勃的） || 文化联想：庙会上舞狮锣鼓一响，整个广场马上热闹起来，最适合帮助记忆 enliven，可以说 **enliven the festival — “Drums and a lion dance can enliven the festival and draw children toward the center of the square.”**

quiz.question: riven __ ________
quiz.explanation: 分裂的, 被冲突分裂. The nation was riven by conflict. 国家被冲突分裂。 | rive->撕裂（古英语），riven->被撕裂的=分裂的（cf. river河流=撕裂大地的水） || 文化联想：中文“四分五裂”最适合帮助记忆 riven，可以说 **riven by conflict — “A family or organization divided into hostile factions can become riven by conflict—‘四分五裂.’”**

quiz.question: _______' coven
quiz.explanation: 女巫集会, 女巫集会. The story featured a secret witches' coven. 故事以秘密女巫集会为特色。 | coven->聚集（来自convent修道院），coven->女巫聚会（通常13人，对应最后晚餐） || 文化联想：coven 是西方女巫文化概念，可用中国读者熟悉的奇幻小说语境来记忆，可以说 **a witches’ coven — “In a translated fantasy novel read by Chinese fans, a witches’ coven may gather secretly to perform magic.”**

quiz.question: ______ sloven
quiz.explanation: 邋遢的人, 邋遢的人. The untidy sloven never cleaned his room. 邋遢的人从不打扫他的房间。 | sloven->邋遢的人（古法语eslouvé->粗心），slovenly->邋遢的 || 文化联想：中文“邋遢鬼”最适合帮助记忆 sloven，可以说 **an untidy sloven — “Someone who never washes dishes, changes clothes, or cleans the room may be called an untidy sloven—一个‘邋遢鬼.’”**

quiz.question: ________ doyen
quiz.explanation: 资深人士, 行业资深人士. He was the industry doyen of journalism. 他是新闻业的资深人士。 | doyen->十人之首（法语，来自拉丁decanus），doyen->某领域最资深者（cf. dean院长） || 文化联想：梅兰芳作为京剧界重要前辈的形象最适合帮助记忆 doyen，可以说 **a doyen of Peking opera — “Mei Lanfang is often remembered as a doyen of Peking opera whose influence extended far beyond the stage.”**

quiz.question: brazen ___
quiz.explanation: 厚颜无耻的, 厚颜无耻的谎言. The politician told a brazen lie. 政客说了一个厚颜无耻的谎言。 | brass->黄铜，brazen->黄铜般厚脸皮的=厚颜无耻的（cf. brass nerve厚脸皮） || 文化联想：中文“睁眼说瞎话、厚颜无耻”最适合帮助记忆 brazen，可以说 **a brazen lie — “Denying something that was clearly recorded on video would be a brazen lie—简直是‘睁眼说瞎话.’”**

quiz.question: bedizen _______
quiz.explanation: 俗丽地装饰, 俗丽地装饰自己. She would bedizen oneself with gaudy jewelry. 她会用俗丽的珠宝装饰自己。 | be->使，dizen->盛装，bedizen->过度俗丽地打扮=俗气装扮 || 文化联想：中文“花枝招展、珠光宝气”最适合帮助记忆 bedizen，可以说 **bedizen oneself — “A character who covers herself in oversized gold ornaments and bright accessories may bedizen herself in a deliberately gaudy style.”**

quiz.question: _____ denizen
quiz.explanation: 居民, 城市居民. Urban denizen adapted to city life. 城市居民适应了城市生活。 | deinz->内部（古法语），denizen->在内部的人=居民/归化公民（cf. citizen公民） || 文化联想：北上广深的普通城市居民最适合帮助记忆 denizen，可以说 **an urban denizen — “An urban denizen of Shanghai may rely on the subway, delivery apps, and neighborhood convenience stores every day.”**

quiz.question: wizen ____ ___
quiz.explanation: 枯萎, 随年龄枯萎. His face began to wizen with age. 他的脸随着年龄开始枯萎。 | wizen->干枯（古英语wisnian），wizened->干瘪枯萎的（老人面孔） || 文化联想：长期风吹日晒使高原老人面部干瘪起皱的画面最适合帮助记忆 wizen，可以说 **wizen with age — “Years of sun, wind, and age can wizen a weather-beaten face until the skin looks deeply lined and dry.”**

quiz.question: cozen _ ______
quiz.explanation: 欺骗, 欺骗客户. The dishonest lawyer would cozen a client. 不诚实的律师会欺骗客户。 | cozen->欺骗（可能来自cousin表亲，像亲戚般套近乎行骗），cozen->哄骗欺诈 || 文化联想：中文“套近乎把客户哄骗了”最适合帮助记忆 cozen，可以说 **cozen a client — “A dishonest adviser may first gain trust through friendly talk and then cozen a client into paying for a worthless scheme.”**

quiz.question: condign __________
quiz.explanation: 应得的, 应得的惩罚. The judge imposed condign punishment. 法官施加了应得的惩罚。 | con->完全，dign->应得（拉丁dignus->值得），condign->完全应得的（cf. dignity尊严，dignify使有价值） || 文化联想：中文“罪有应得”最适合帮助记忆 condign，可以说 **condign punishment — “A corrupt official convicted after stealing disaster-relief money may be said to receive condign punishment—‘罪有应得.’”**

quiz.question: deign __ _____
quiz.explanation: 屈尊, 屈尊回复. He wouldn't deign to reply to critics. 他不会屈尊回复批评者。 | dign->值得，deign->认为值得屈尊=纡尊降贵（cf. dignity尊严，condign应得的） || 文化联想：中文“连回一句都不屑”最适合帮助记忆 deign，可以说 **deign to reply — “An arrogant celebrity may refuse even to deign to reply to ordinary criticism—连回一句都觉得是‘屈尊.’”**

quiz.question: reign _______
quiz.explanation: 统治, 至高无上的统治. The champion would reign supreme for years. 冠军将至高无上地统治多年。 | reg->统治（拉丁），reign->统治（注意g不发音，cf. rein缰绳，rain雨，三词同音） || 文化联想：中国乒乓球运动员长期保持世界顶尖水平的场景很适合帮助记忆 reign，可以说 **reign supreme — “A champion who dominates international competition for several seasons may reign supreme in the sport.”**

quiz.question: sovereign _____
quiz.explanation: 主权的, 主权国家. Every sovereign state has independent authority. 每个主权国家都有独立的权威。 | super->在上，reign->统治，sovereign->在上统治的=主权的（注意g不发音） || 文化联想：中文“主权国家”最适合帮助记忆 sovereign，可以说 **a sovereign state — “A sovereign state exercises authority over its own territory and conducts relations with other states.”**

quiz.question: _________ realign
quiz.explanation: 重新排列, 政治重组. Parties began to political realign after the crisis. 危机后各政党开始政治重组。 | re->重新，align->排成一列，realign->重新排列=重组（cf. alignment对齐） || 文化联想：公司战略改变后重新调整团队目标最适合帮助记忆 realign，可以说 **realign priorities — “After market conditions change, a company may realign priorities and move resources toward more important projects.”**

quiz.question: malign ______
quiz.explanation: 恶意的, 恶意意图. The accusation revealed malign intent. 指控显示了恶意意图。 | mal->坏，lign->出生，malign->天生坏的=恶意的（cf. benign良性的，malignant恶性的） || 文化联想：中文“恶意中伤”最适合帮助记忆 malign，可以说 **malign a rival — “Spreading invented stories to damage a competitor’s reputation is to malign a rival—也就是‘恶意中伤.’”**

quiz.question: benign _____
quiz.explanation: 良性的, 良性肿瘤. The doctor confirmed it was a benign tumor. 医生证实这是良性肿瘤。 | ben->好，lign->出生，benign->天生好的=良性的（cf. malign恶意的，benevolent仁慈的） || 文化联想：中文医院里“良性肿瘤”最适合帮助记忆 benign，可以说 **a benign tumor — “A benign tumor does not invade nearby tissues in the same way a malignant cancer does, though it may still require medical attention.”**

quiz.question: _____ ensign
quiz.explanation: 少尉, 海军少尉. The naval ensign saluted his superior officer. 海军少尉向他的上级军官敬礼。 | en->在，sign->标志，ensign->旗帜/旗手=少尉（cf. insignia徽章，sign标志） || 文化联想：海军舰艇悬挂舰旗的画面最适合帮助记忆 ensign，可以说 **a naval ensign — “A naval vessel entering harbor may fly a naval ensign from the stern.”**

quiz.question: consign _____
quiz.explanation: 托运, 托运货物. The merchant would consign goods to dealers. 商人会向经销商托运货物。 | con->共同，sign->签名，consign->共同签名交付=托运（cf. consignment托运货物） || 文化联想：中国电商和外贸仓库把货物交给承运人发运的场景最适合帮助记忆 consign，可以说 **consign goods — “An exporter may consign goods to a shipping company for delivery to an overseas buyer.”**

quiz.question: impugn _______
quiz.explanation: 质疑, 质疑动机. Critics began to impugn motives behind the decision. 批评者开始质疑决定背后的动机。 | im->攻击，pugn->拳击（拉丁pugnus->拳头），impugn->用拳头攻击=质疑挑战（cf. pugilism拳击） || 文化联想：中文“质疑他的动机”最适合帮助记忆 impugn，可以说 **impugn someone’s motives — “In a heated public debate, one side may impugn an opponent’s motives instead of answering the actual argument.”**

quiz.question: ordain _ ______
quiz.explanation: 授予圣职, 授予神父圣职. The bishop will ordain a priest next Sunday. 主教将在下周日授予神父圣职。 | ordin->秩序（拉丁），ordain->将某人纳入神圣秩序=授予圣职（cf. order秩序，ordinance法令） || 文化联想：佛教寺院举行受戒仪式、正式授予僧人身份最适合帮助记忆 ordain，可以说 **ordain a monk — “At a formal Buddhist ordination ceremony, senior clergy may ordain a monk according to established religious rules.”**

quiz.question: ____ disdain
quiz.explanation: 蔑视, 表现蔑视. He would openly show disdain for rules. 他会公开表现对规则的蔑视。 | dis->否定，dign->值得，disdain->认为不值得=蔑视（cf. dignity尊严，deign屈尊） || 文化联想：中文“不屑一顾”最适合帮助记忆 disdain，可以说 **show disdain — “A snob who looks down on inexpensive street food may show disdain for something enjoyed by ordinary people—‘不屑一顾.’”**

quiz.question: ____ bargain
quiz.explanation: 便宜货, 好便宜货. I got a good bargain at the sale. 我在大减价中得到了好便宜货。 | bargain->讨价还价（古法语bargaignier），bargain->交易/便宜货 || 文化联想：中国菜市场买菜时常会讨价还价，最适合帮助记忆 bargain，可以说 **a good bargain — “A shopper who negotiates a lower price at a morning market may walk away feeling that the vegetables were a good bargain.”**

quiz.question: ____ porcelain
quiz.explanation: 瓷器, 精美瓷器. The museum displayed fine porcelain from China. 博物馆展示了来自中国的精美瓷器。 | porcellana->贝壳（意大利语，因瓷器光滑如贝壳），porcelain->瓷器 || 文化联想：景德镇瓷器是最适合帮助记忆 porcelain 的中国文化形象，可以说 **fine porcelain — “Jingdezhen has long been famous for fine porcelain admired for its delicate body, glaze, and decoration.”**

quiz.question: plain _____
quiz.explanation: 明白的, 明白的真相. He told us the plain truth about the situation. 他告诉我们关于情况的明白真相。 | plain->平坦/简单明了，plain truth->不加修饰的真相（cf. plane飞机/平面，同音） || 文化联想：中文“打开天窗说亮话”最适合帮助记忆 plain，可以说 **the plain truth — “Someone who ‘opens the skylight and speaks plainly’ is trying to tell the plain truth without decoration or evasion.”**

quiz.question: _____________ legerdemain
quiz.explanation: 戏法, 复杂的戏法. The magician performed sophisticated legerdemain. 魔术师表演了复杂的戏法。 | léger->轻，de->的，main->手（法语），legerdemain->手法轻巧=戏法/诡计 || 文化联想：街头魔术师靠手快制造“障眼法”的场景最适合帮助记忆 legerdemain，可以说 **sleight-of-hand legerdemain — “A skilled street magician may use rapid hand movements and misdirection to perform impressive legerdemain.”**

quiz.question: refrain ____
quiz.explanation: 克制, 克制于. Please refrain from smoking in this area. 请在该区域克制吸烟。 | re->回，frain->勒住，refrain->勒回=克制（refrain也指歌曲中的副歌，重复出现） || 文化联想：中国酒桌上不想喝酒时主动克制、婉拒劝酒，最适合帮助记忆 refrain，可以说 **refrain from drinking — “At a banquet, someone who does not drink may politely refrain from drinking even when others propose repeated toasts.”**

quiz.question: grain ____
quiz.explanation: 谷物, 谷物筒仓. The farmer stored wheat in the grain silo. 农民把小麦存放在谷物筒仓里。 | grain->谷粒/纹理，a grain of->一粒（cf. granule颗粒，granary粮仓） || 文化联想：东北粮仓里成吨玉米和小麦入库储存的场景最适合帮助记忆 grain，可以说 **a grain silo — “After the autumn harvest, a large grain silo may store wheat or maize until it is transported or sold.”**

quiz.question: _____ terrain
quiz.explanation: 地形, 岩石地形. Hikers struggled over the rocky terrain. 徒步旅行者在岩石地形上艰难行进。 | terra->土地，terrain->地面状况=地形（cf. territory领土，Mediterranean地中海） || 文化联想：张家界崎岖多石的山路最适合帮助记忆 terrain，可以说 **rocky terrain — “Hikers in Zhangjiajie may cross rocky terrain with steep steps, cliffs, and uneven ground.”**

quiz.question: detain _ _______
quiz.explanation: 拘留, 拘留嫌疑人. Police have authority to detain a suspect. 警察有权拘留嫌疑人。 | de->向下，tain->持有，detain->按住不放=拘留（cf. retain保留，contain容纳） || 文化联想：现代警务中依法暂时拘留犯罪嫌疑人的场景最适合帮助记忆 detain，可以说 **detain a suspect — “Police may detain a suspect according to legal procedure while an investigation continues.”**

quiz.question: retain _______
quiz.explanation: 保留, 保留控制权. The company struggled to retain control. 公司努力保留控制权。 | re->再次，tain->持有，retain->继续持有=保留（cf. retainer保留者/律师预付费） || 文化联想：中文“把老手艺保留下来”最适合帮助记忆 retain，可以说 **retain a tradition — “A family workshop may retain a traditional craft technique even while adopting modern tools.”**

quiz.question: contain ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 控制, 控制蔓延. Measures were taken to contain the spread. 采取措施控制蔓延。 | con->共同，tain->持有，contain->共同持住=容纳/控制（cf. container容器） || 文化联想：传染病防控里尽快控制传播范围最适合帮助记忆 contain，可以说 **contain the spread — “Rapid testing, isolation, and hygiene measures can help contain the spread of an infectious disease.”**

quiz.question: stain _______
quiz.explanation: 污渍, 去污剂. Use stain remover for tough marks. 使用去污剂去除顽固污渍。 | stain->染色/污渍（古挪威steina->涂色），stain->弄脏/污点（cf. stainless无锈的） || 文化联想：长期喝茶后杯壁留下褐色茶渍最适合帮助记忆 stain，可以说 **a tea stain — “A porcelain cup used every day may develop a brown tea stain around the inside rim.”**

quiz.question: _____ ____ distain
quiz.explanation: 玷污, 用污渍玷污. The scandal would stain with distain his reputation. 丑闻会用污渍玷污他的声誉。 | dis->彻底，tain->染色，distain->彻底染污=玷污（古词，现多用stain） || 文化联想：中文“玷污门楣、败坏名声”最适合帮助记忆 distain，可以说 **distain a reputation — “A serious scandal can distain a once-respected family reputation—中文可以联想到‘玷污门楣.’”**

quiz.question: sustain ______
quiz.explanation: 维持, 维持增长. The economy must sustain growth. 经济必须维持增长。 | sus->在下，tain->持有，sustain->在下面撑住=维持（cf. sustainable可持续的） || 文化联想：中文“细水长流”最适合帮助记忆 sustain，可以说 **sustain growth — “A business that expands steadily without exhausting its resources is more likely to sustain growth over many years.”**

quiz.question: attain _ ____
quiz.explanation: 达到, 达到目标. With hard work, you can attain a goal. 通过努力工作,你可以达到目标。 | at->朝向，tain->持有/触及，attain->触及目标=达到（cf. obtain获得，obtain=ob+tain） || 文化联想：“有志者事竟成”最适合帮助记忆 attain，可以说 **attain a goal — “Someone who persists through years of study may eventually attain a difficult goal—‘有志者事竟成.’”**

quiz.question: _____ bin
quiz.explanation: 垃圾箱, 垃圾箱. Please put litter in the trash bin. 请把垃圾放进垃圾箱。 | bin->箱子（古英语binn->篮），trash bin->垃圾箱（cf. dustbin垃圾桶） || 文化联想：上海等城市推行垃圾分类时不同颜色的垃圾桶最适合帮助记忆 bin，可以说 **a trash bin — “A resident sorting household waste places each item into the appropriate trash bin.”**

quiz.question: _________ din
quiz.explanation: 喧闹, 震耳欲聋的喧闹. The construction created a deafening din. 建筑工地制造了震耳欲聋的喧闹。 | din->持续的噪音（古英语dyne），din->嘈杂声（cf. dine用餐，同音不同义） || 文化联想：春节一串鞭炮在窄巷里同时炸响的声音最适合帮助记忆 din，可以说 **a deafening din — “Firecrackers exploding one after another in a narrow alley can create a deafening din.”**

quiz.question: ____ skein
quiz.explanation: 一绞, 一绞纱线. She bought a yarn skein for knitting. 她买了一绞纱线用于编织。 | skein->一绞线（古法语escaigne），a skein of->一绞/一群（飞鸟也用此词） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠使用一绞绞丝线配色刺绣，最适合帮助记忆 skein，可以说 **a skein of silk — “A Suzhou embroiderer may unwind a skein of silk before separating the fine threads needed for a detailed pattern.”**

quiz.question: urchin ___
quiz.explanation: 顽童, 顽童男孩. The urchin boy begged on the streets. 顽童男孩在街上乞讨。 | urchin->刺猬/顽童（古法语），sea urchin->海胆（形如刺猬），street urchin->街头顽童 || 文化联想：老上海弄堂故事里的淘气孩子最适合帮助记忆 urchin，可以说 **a street urchin — “A mischievous child darting through the alleys of an old-city story may be portrayed as a street urchin.”**

quiz.question: _____ kin
quiz.explanation: 亲属, 近亲. She visited her close kin regularly. 她定期拜访她的近亲。 | kin->亲族（古英语cynn），next of kin->最近亲属（cf. kind善良/种类，同词根） || 文化联想：“血浓于水”最适合帮助记忆 kin，可以说 **close kin — “During Spring Festival, many people travel long distances to reunite with close kin—体现‘血浓于水’的亲情.”**

quiz.question: maudlin _________
quiz.explanation: 感伤的, 感伤的情绪. The movie was criticized for maudlin sentiment. 这部电影因感伤的情绪而受到批评。 | Maudlin->Mary Magdalene的变形（圣经中常哭泣），maudlin->过度感伤的=感伤的 || 文化联想：中文“苦情剧煽情过头”最适合帮助记忆 maudlin，可以说 **maudlin sentiment — “A television drama that piles tragedy upon tragedy simply to make viewers cry can descend into maudlin sentiment.”**

quiz.question: tarpaulin _____
quiz.explanation: 防水布, 防水布罩. Workers placed a tarpaulin cover over the cargo. 工人在货物上放置了防水布罩。 | tar->焦油，paulin->布（pall布），tarpaulin->涂了焦油的防水布 || 文化联想：南方梅雨季商贩用防水布盖住货物的场景最适合帮助记忆 tarpaulin，可以说 **a tarpaulin cover — “When heavy rain arrives, a market vendor may pull a tarpaulin cover over boxes of goods to keep them dry.”**

quiz.question: _______ rejoin
quiz.explanation: 回答, 机智地回答. She would wittily rejoin to criticism. 她会机智地回答批评。 | re->回，join->加入/回应，rejoin->回应=机智反驳（cf. rejoinder反驳） || 文化联想：相声里的捧哏常能一句话机智回嘴，最适合帮助记忆 rejoin，可以说 **rejoin wittily — “A xiangsheng performer may rejoin wittily when his partner makes a deliberately ridiculous claim.”**

quiz.question: enjoin _______ ____
quiz.explanation: 禁止, 禁止某人. The court will enjoin someone from further action. 法院将禁止某人采取进一步行动。 | en->加强，join->命令（拉丁），enjoin->命令/禁止（cf. injunction禁令） || 文化联想：知识产权纠纷中法院命令停止某种行为的场景可帮助记忆 enjoin，可以说 **enjoin further use — “A court order may enjoin a company from continuing to use disputed material while the case is being decided.”**

quiz.question: conjoin ______
quiz.explanation: 结合, 结合力量. Allies decided to conjoin forces. 盟友决定结合力量。 | con->共同，join->连接，conjoin->共同连接=结合（cf. conjunction连词，joint关节） || 文化联想：战国“合纵”让多个诸侯国联合力量的形象最适合帮助记忆 conjoin，可以说 **conjoin forces — “The idea of the Vertical Alliance can be remembered as several states attempting to conjoin forces against a stronger rival.”**

quiz.question: purloin _ ______
quiz.explanation: 偷窃, 偷窃信件. The spy managed to purloin a letter. 间谍设法偷窃了信件。 | pur->远离，loin->放置（古法语），purloin->偷偷放到远处=偷窃（cf. Poe的《失窃的信》） || 文化联想：成语“顺手牵羊”最适合帮助记忆 purloin，可以说 **purloin a small item — “Someone who quietly slips another person’s property into a pocket may purloin a small item—‘顺手牵羊.’”**

quiz.question: spin ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 编造, 编造故事. Politicians often spin the story to their advantage. 政客经常为自己的利益编造故事。 | spin->旋转/纺纱，spin a story->像纺纱一样编故事（cf. spin doctor政治公关） || 文化联想：中文网络里的“带节奏”最适合帮助记忆 spin，可以说 **spin the story — “An account that selects facts to push one preferred narrative may spin the story—中文网络常说在‘带节奏.’”**

quiz.question: saccharin _________
quiz.explanation: 糖精, 糖精甜味. The drink had an artificial saccharin sweetness. 这种饮料有人工的糖精甜味。 | sacchar->糖（希腊sakkharon），saccharin->人工甜味剂（cf. saccharine过甜的/甜腻的） || 文化联想：一些老式廉价甜饮料带有明显人工糖精味，最适合帮助记忆 saccharin，可以说 **saccharin sweetness — “An artificially sweet drink can have a sharp saccharin sweetness quite different from the taste of fruit or cane sugar.”**

quiz.question: grin _______
quiz.explanation: 露齿笑, 开心地露齿笑. He began to grin broadly at the joke. 他开始对这个笑话开心地露齿笑。 | grin->露齿而笑（古英语grennian），grin and bear it->咬牙忍受 || 文化联想：中文“笑得合不拢嘴”最适合帮助记忆 grin，可以说 **grin broadly — “A child receiving a large red envelope at New Year may grin broadly—笑得合不拢嘴.”**

quiz.question: ____ chagrin
quiz.explanation: 懊恼, 感到懊恼. She would feel chagrin at the mistake. 她会对错误感到懊恼。 | chagrin->粗砺（法语，磨损感），chagrin->因受挫而懊恼（cf. chagrined懊恼的） || 文化联想：中文“懊恼得直拍大腿”最适合帮助记忆 chagrin，可以说 **feel chagrin — “A mahjong player who discards the winning tile by mistake may feel chagrin and slap a thigh in frustration.”**

quiz.question: ____ resin
quiz.explanation: 树脂, 松树脂. Pine resin was used to seal boats. 松树脂被用来密封船只。 | resin->树脂（拉丁resina），pine resin->松香（cf. rosin松香，violin弓用） || 文化联想：二胡演奏前会在弓毛上擦松香，而松香来自松树树脂，最适合帮助记忆 resin，可以说 **pine resin — “Pine resin can be processed into rosin, which musicians rub onto bow hair to create enough friction on the strings.”**

quiz.question: toxin ________
quiz.explanation: 毒素, 毒素暴露. Workers feared toxin exposure at the plant. 工人担心在工厂的毒素暴露。 | tox->毒（希腊toxikon->箭毒），toxin->毒素（cf. toxic有毒的，antitoxin抗毒素） || 文化联想：河豚毒素是中国饮食安全讨论中很容易记住的毒素例子，最适合帮助记忆 toxin，可以说 **a potent toxin — “Improperly prepared pufferfish can contain a potent toxin capable of causing severe poisoning.”**

quiz.question: condemn ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 谴责, 谴责袭击. World leaders united to condemn the attack. 世界领导人团结起来谴责袭击。 | con->加强，demn->损害（拉丁damnare），condemn->强烈定罪=谴责（cf. damn该死） || 文化联想：中文“人人都该谴责腐败”最适合帮助记忆 condemn，可以说 **condemn corruption — “A public statement may condemn corruption and call for transparent investigation and accountability.”**

quiz.question: solemn ________
quiz.explanation: 庄严的, 庄严的仪式. The memorial featured a solemn ceremony. 纪念活动以庄严的仪式为特色。 | solemn->每年一次的（拉丁sollemnis），solemn->庄严隆重的（cf. solemnity庄严） || 文化联想：清明纪念活动安静、肃穆的氛围最适合帮助记忆 solemn，可以说 **a solemn ceremony — “A Qingming memorial may become a solemn ceremony as family members stand quietly before an ancestral grave.”**

quiz.question: limn _ ________
quiz.explanation: 描绘, 描绘肖像. The artist would limn a portrait in detail. 艺术家会详细描绘肖像。 | limn->彩绘（来自illuminate照亮），limn->用线条描绘（cf. illuminate手稿彩饰） || 文化联想：中国水墨画用简练线条勾勒山水轮廓最适合帮助记忆 limn，可以说 **limn a landscape — “An ink painter may limn a mountain landscape with a few controlled brushstrokes before adding washes of ink.”**

quiz.question: ______ hymn
quiz.explanation: 赞美诗, 教堂赞美诗. The congregation sang a church hymn. 会众唱了教堂赞美诗。 | hymnos->颂歌（希腊），hymn->宗教赞美诗（注意n不发音，cf. hymnal赞美诗集） || 文化联想：hymn 是基督宗教赞美诗，可用中国教堂礼拜中的唱诗来记忆，可以说 **a church hymn — “During Sunday worship in a church in China, the congregation may sing a church hymn together.”**

quiz.question: beacon _____
quiz.explanation: 信标, 信标灯. The beacon light guided ships to shore. 信标灯引导船只靠岸。 | beacon->火焰信号（古英语beacen），beacon->灯塔/榜样（cf. beckon招手，形近） || 文化联想：沿海灯塔在夜间给船只指引方向的场景最适合帮助记忆 beacon，可以说 **a beacon light — “A lighthouse on the Chinese coast sends out a beacon light that helps vessels identify the shoreline at night.”**

quiz.question: ___ pantechnicon
quiz.explanation: 搬家车, 旧搬家车. An old pantechnicon transported furniture. 一辆旧搬家车运送家具。 | pan->全部，techni->技艺，pantechnicon->百货仓库（后转指搬家大货车） || 文化联想：pantechnicon 是英式英语里的大型搬家车，可用中国学生阅读英国小说时的搬家场景来记忆，可以说 **a pantechnicon moving van — “A Chinese reader of an old British novel may picture a pantechnicon as a large moving van packed with furniture and household goods.”**

quiz.question: _____ lexicon
quiz.explanation: 词汇, 法律词汇. Lawyers must master the legal lexicon. 律师必须掌握法律词汇。 | lexis->词语（希腊），lexicon->某领域词汇总集=词汇表（cf. lexical词汇的，dyslexia阅读障碍） || 文化联想：“内卷、躺平、吃瓜”等网络词汇构成很有中国特色的网络词库，最适合帮助记忆 lexicon，可以说 **an online lexicon — “Expressions such as ‘内卷,’ ‘躺平,’ and ‘吃瓜’ have become part of the modern Chinese online lexicon.”**

quiz.question: ______ curmudgeon
quiz.explanation: 脾气坏的老头, 脾气暴躁的老头. The cranky curmudgeon complained about everything. 脾气暴躁的老头抱怨一切。 | curmudgeon->来源不明，指脾气暴躁吝啬的老人（cf. grouch抱怨者） || 文化联想：中文“脾气古怪、天天抱怨的老头”最适合帮助记忆 curmudgeon，可以说 **a cranky curmudgeon — “A neighbor who complains about children, traffic, weather, and every new change may seem like a cranky curmudgeon.”**

quiz.question: _____ surgeon
quiz.explanation: 外科医生, 心脏外科医生. The heart surgeon performed a bypass. 心脏外科医生进行了搭桥手术。 | chir->手，urg->工作（希腊），surgeon->用手操作的医生=外科医生（cf. surgery外科手术） || 文化联想：中国大型医院里的心脏外科最适合帮助记忆 surgeon，可以说 **a heart surgeon — “A heart surgeon may spend hours performing a complex operation while a specialized team monitors the patient.”**

quiz.question: _____ pantheon
quiz.explanation: 万神殿, 罗马万神殿. The Roman pantheon is an architectural marvel. 罗马万神殿是建筑奇迹。 | pan->全部，theon->神，pantheon->供奉所有神的殿=万神殿 || 文化联想：李白、杜甫都属于中国诗歌最杰出的代表人物，最适合帮助记忆 pantheon，可以说 **the pantheon of Chinese poetry — “Li Bai and Du Fu occupy permanent places in the pantheon of Chinese poetry.”**

quiz.question: _ paragon __ ______
quiz.explanation: 典范, 美德的典范. She was considered a paragon of virtue. 她被认为是美德的典范。 | para->旁边，gon->磨石（希腊），paragon->磨砺出来的最佳典范 || 文化联想：中文“品德楷模”最适合帮助记忆 paragon，可以说 **a paragon of virtue — “A person repeatedly praised for honesty, generosity, and self-discipline may be held up as a paragon of virtue.”**

quiz.question: _______ hexagon
quiz.explanation: 六边形, 正六边形. A honeycomb forms a regular hexagon pattern. 蜂巢形成正六边形图案。 | hex->六（希腊），gon->角，hexagon->六角形（cf. pentagon五边形，octagon八边形） || 文化联想：蜂巢六边形结构是中国中学数学和自然课里很直观的几何形象，最适合帮助记忆 hexagon，可以说 **a regular hexagon — “A honeycomb cell is often modeled as a regular hexagon with six equal sides.”**

quiz.question: _________ jargon
quiz.explanation: 行话, 技术行话. The manual was filled with technical jargon. 手册充满了技术行话。 | jargon->鸟鸣（古法语），jargon->像鸟叫一样让人听不懂的行话 || 文化联想：中文职场里的“黑话”最适合帮助记忆 jargon，可以说 **technical jargon — “A new employee may struggle when a meeting is filled with technical jargon and unexplained abbreviations—也就是一堆‘黑话.’”**

quiz.question: ______ suspicion
quiz.explanation: 怀疑, 引起怀疑. His behavior began to arouse suspicion. 他的行为开始引起怀疑。 | sus->从下，spec->看，suspicion->从下面偷看=怀疑（cf. suspect怀疑，inspector检察官） || 文化联想：“瓜田不纳履，李下不整冠”最适合帮助记忆 suspicion，可以说 **arouse suspicion — “Avoiding questionable behavior under a melon patch or plum tree reflects the old warning not to arouse suspicion.”**

quiz.question: ___ coercion
quiz.explanation: 强制, 使用强制. The confession was obtained by use coercion. 供词是通过使用强制获得的。 | co->共同，erc->围住（拉丁），coercion->围住迫使=强制（cf. coerce强迫） || 文化联想：“强扭的瓜不甜”最适合帮助记忆 coercion，可以说 **under coercion — “An agreement made only under coercion rarely reflects genuine willingness—正如‘强扭的瓜不甜.’”**

quiz.question: scion __ _ ______
quiz.explanation: 后裔, 家族后裔. He was the scion of a family dynasty. 他是家族王朝的后裔。 | scion->嫩枝/幼芽（园艺），scion->家族的新枝=后裔（cf. scissors剪刀，同词根sci->切） || 文化联想：中文“世家子弟”最适合帮助记忆 scion，可以说 **a scion of a prominent family — “A young heir raised inside an influential old family may be described as a scion of a prominent family.”**

quiz.question: _ legion __ ____
quiz.explanation: 大批, 大批粉丝. The singer attracted a legion of fans. 歌手吸引了大批粉丝。 | legion->罗马军团（约5000人），legion->大批（cf. legionnaire军团士兵） || 文化联想：春运时数以千万计的旅客组成“春运大军”，最适合帮助记忆 legion，可以说 **a legion of travelers — “During the Spring Festival travel rush, a legion of travelers moves through railway stations and airports across the country.”**

quiz.question: ____ battalion
quiz.explanation: 营, 陆军营. The army battalion deployed to the border. 陆军营部署到边境。 | battail->战斗（古法语），battalion->战斗单位=营（约500-800人，cf. battle战役） || 文化联想：抗战题材历史叙事里的一个营级部队最适合帮助记忆 battalion，可以说 **an infantry battalion — “In a wartime account, an infantry battalion may be assigned to defend a strategically important position.”**

quiz.question: ______ rapscallion
quiz.explanation: 流氓, 小流氓. The little rapscallion stole from the market. 小流氓从市场偷东西。 | rascal->无赖，rapscallion->rascal的强化变形=顽劣小流氓（cf. rascal无赖） || 文化联想：中文“淘气鬼、小无赖”最适合帮助记忆 rapscallion，可以说 **a little rapscallion — “A mischievous boy who steals dates from a neighbor’s tree and runs away laughing might be called a little rapscallion.”**

quiz.question: ____ bullion
quiz.explanation: 金条, 金条. The vault contained gold bullion bars. 金库里有金条。 | bouillon->沸腾（法语，熔化金属），bullion->熔铸的金属块=金条/银条 || 文化联想：中国家庭购买投资金条或银行金库里的金条最适合帮助记忆 bullion，可以说 **gold bullion — “An investor may buy standardized gold bullion rather than jewelry when the goal is simply to hold physical gold.”**

quiz.question: ______ companion
quiz.explanation: 同伴, 旅行同伴. She found a reliable travel companion. 她找到了一个可靠的旅行同伴。 | com->共同，pan->面包（拉丁），companion->共同分享面包的人=同伴（cf. company公司） || 文化联想：中文“驴友”最适合帮助记忆 companion，可以说 **a travel companion — “A reliable ‘驴友’ who hikes and shares expenses with you can become an excellent travel companion.”**

quiz.question: champion ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 拥护, 拥护事业. Activists champion the cause of justice. 活动家拥护正义事业。 | campus->战场（拉丁），champion->战场上的斗士=冠军/拥护者 || 文化联想：中文“为公益事业奔走”最适合帮助记忆 champion，可以说 **champion a cause — “A respected public figure may champion the cause of rural education by raising funds and attention for village schools.”**

quiz.question: _________ scorpion
quiz.explanation: 蝎子, 有毒的蝎子. The desert harbored poisonous scorpion. 沙漠藏有有毒的蝎子。 | scorpion->蝎子（拉丁scorpio），Scorpio->天蝎座，scorpion->蝎子 || 文化联想：新疆、甘肃等干旱地区可见蝎子，最适合帮助记忆 scorpion，可以说 **a poisonous scorpion — “In a dry desert environment, a poisonous scorpion may hide beneath a rock during the heat of the day.”**

quiz.question: clarion ____
quiz.explanation: 嘹亮的, 嘹亮的号召. The leader issued a clarion call to action. 领导人发出了嘹亮的行动号召。 | clari->清亮（拉丁clarus），clarion->发出清亮声音的号角=嘹亮的（cf. clarity清晰） || 文化联想：五四时期对“科学与民主”的呼喊很适合帮助记忆 clarion，可以说 **a clarion call for change — “Calls for science, democracy, and cultural renewal during the May Fourth era became a clarion call for change.”**

quiz.question: __________ criterion
quiz.explanation: 标准, 评估标准. Quality is the primary evaluation criterion. 质量是主要的评估标准。 | crit->判断（希腊），criterion->判断的依据=标准（复数criteria，cf. critic批评家） || 文化联想：高考录取会按照成绩等明确条件筛选，最适合帮助记忆 criterion，可以说 **an admission criterion — “An examination score may be one important admission criterion used by a university.”**

quiz.question: carrion ______
quiz.explanation: 腐肉, 食腐动物. Vultures are carrion feeder birds. 秃鹫是食腐动物。 | caro->肉（拉丁），carrion->腐烂的肉（cf. carnivore肉食动物，carnival嘉年华=吃肉节） || 文化联想：青藏高原上的秃鹫取食动物尸体，是 carrion 最直观的自然场景，可以说 **a carrion feeder — “A vulture circling above the plateau is a carrion feeder that survives largely by eating dead animals.”**

quiz.question: _____ centurion
quiz.explanation: 百夫长, 罗马百夫长. The Roman centurion commanded one hundred soldiers. 罗马百夫长指挥一百名士兵。 | centur->百（拉丁centum），centurion->指挥百人的军官=百夫长（cf. century世纪，cent分） || 文化联想：centurion 是古罗马军官，可用中国学生学习世界史时的“罗马百夫长”来记忆，可以说 **a Roman centurion — “In a world-history class, Chinese students may learn that a Roman centurion commanded a unit within the Roman army.”**

quiz.question: ____ abrasion
quiz.explanation: 擦伤, 皮肤擦伤. The fall caused a minor skin abrasion. 跌倒造成了轻微的皮肤擦伤。 | ab->去除，ras->刮擦，abrasion->刮去表面=擦伤（cf. abrasive研磨剂，erase擦除） || 文化联想：中文“摔破一层皮”最适合帮助记忆 abrasion，可以说 **a skin abrasion — “A child who falls on a rough school playground may suffer a minor skin abrasion on the knee.”**

quiz.question: ___ evasion
quiz.explanation: 逃避, 逃税. The businessman was charged with tax evasion. 这位商人被指控逃税。 | e->向外，vas->走，evasion->走出去逃开=逃避（cf. evade逃避，evasive回避的） || 文化联想：中文财经新闻里的“逃税”最适合帮助记忆 evasion，可以说 **tax evasion — “Deliberately hiding taxable income or falsifying records can constitute tax evasion.”**

quiz.question: _____ cohesion
quiz.explanation: 凝聚力, 团队凝聚力. Strong leadership promotes group cohesion. 强有力的领导促进团队凝聚力。 | co->共同，hes->粘（拉丁haerere），cohesion->粘在一起=凝聚力（cf. adhesion附着，coherent连贯的） || 文化联想：“众人拾柴火焰高”最适合帮助记忆 cohesion，可以说 **team cohesion — “A group that works in the spirit of ‘many hands make the fire burn higher’ can build strong team cohesion.”**

quiz.question: ____ lesion
quiz.explanation: 损伤, 皮肤损伤. The doctor examined the skin lesion carefully. 医生仔细检查了皮肤损伤。 | laes->伤害（拉丁laedere），lesion->受伤的部位=损伤（cf. lesion区别collision碰撞） || 文化联想：皮肤科检查一个异常红斑或破损区域最适合帮助记忆 lesion，可以说 **a skin lesion — “A dermatologist may examine a suspicious skin lesion to determine whether further testing is needed.”**

quiz.question: ________ incision
quiz.explanation: 切口, 手术切口. The surgeon made a precise surgical incision. 外科医生做了精确的手术切口。 | in->进入，cis->切，incision->切进去=切口（cf. scissors剪刀，decide决定=切断犹豫） || 文化联想：外科手术留下的切口最适合帮助记忆 incision，可以说 **a surgical incision — “A surgeon makes a surgical incision carefully and closes it after the operation is complete.”**

quiz.question: ____-__ collision
quiz.explanation: 碰撞, 正面碰撞. The vehicles were involved in a head-on collision. 车辆发生了正面碰撞。 | col->共同，lis->撞击，collision->共同撞在一起=碰撞（cf. collide碰撞） || 文化联想：早晚高峰追尾事故最适合帮助记忆 collision，可以说 **a rear-end collision — “Sudden braking in heavy city traffic can cause a rear-end collision between two cars.”**

quiz.question: _____ prevision
quiz.explanation: 预见, 清晰的预见. The prophet claimed clear prevision of events. 先知声称对事件有清晰的预见。 | pre->提前，vis->看，prevision->提前看到=预见（cf. preview预览，provision预备） || 文化联想：“未雨绸缪”最适合帮助记忆 prevision，可以说 **prevision of future needs — “Building extra water-storage capacity before a drought shows prevision of future needs—‘未雨绸缪.’”**

quiz.question: envision ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 设想, 设想未来. Leaders must envision the future. 领导者必须设想未来。 | en->使，vis->看，envision->在心中看到=设想（cf. vision视野，visual视觉的） || 文化联想：深圳等城市规划者常提前想象未来交通和城市形态，最适合帮助记忆 envision，可以说 **envision the future — “Urban planners may envision the future as a city linked by denser public transit and more walkable neighborhoods.”**

quiz.question: ____ provision
quiz.explanation: 供应, 食物供应. Hikers packed food provision for the trip. 徒步旅行者为旅行准备了食物供应。 | pro->提前，vis->看/准备，provision->提前准备=供应/条款（cf. provide提供，provisional临时的） || 文化联想：“手中有粮，心中不慌”的应急储备观念最适合帮助记忆 provision，可以说 **make provision for emergencies — “A family that keeps food, water, medicine, and savings on hand is making provision for emergencies.”**

quiz.question: ______ repulsion
quiz.explanation: 排斥, 强烈的排斥. She felt strong repulsion at the sight. 她对这景象感到强烈的排斥。 | re->回，puls->推，repulsion->推回去=排斥（cf. repel排斥，propulsion推进，compulsion强迫） || 文化联想：中文“厌恶得避之不及”最适合帮助记忆 repulsion，可以说 **strong repulsion — “A person who cannot stand the smell of spoiled food may feel strong repulsion and immediately step away.”**

quiz.question: ____________ compulsion
quiz.explanation: 强迫, 不可抗拒的强迫. He felt an irresistible compulsion to confess. 他感到一种不可抗拒的坦白强迫。 | com->共同，puls->推，compulsion->合力推动=强迫（cf. compel强迫，impulsive冲动的） || 文化联想：“强扭的瓜不甜”也最适合帮助记忆 compulsion，可以说 **act under compulsion — “Someone who agrees only because of threats is acting under compulsion rather than by free choice.”**

quiz.question: ______ propulsion
quiz.explanation: 推进, 火箭推进. The spacecraft uses rocket propulsion. 航天器使用火箭推进。 | pro->向前，puls->推，propulsion->向前推=推进（cf. propel推进，propeller螺旋桨） || 文化联想：中国航天火箭发动机提供向上的推进力，最适合帮助记忆 propulsion，可以说 **rocket propulsion — “A launch vehicle relies on rocket propulsion to produce the thrust needed to rise from the launch pad.”**

quiz.question: ______ convulsion
quiz.explanation: 痉挛, 肌肉痉挛. The patient experienced muscle convulsion. 患者经历了肌肉痉挛。 | con->共同，vuls->扯拉，convulsion->全身扯拉=痉挛/剧变（cf. convulse使痉挛，revulsion强烈反感） || 文化联想：小儿高烧时可能出现抽搐，是 convulsion 很直观的医学场景，可以说 **a febrile convulsion — “A young child with a rapidly rising fever can sometimes suffer a febrile convulsion.”**

quiz.question: _____ mansion
quiz.explanation: 豪宅, 宏伟的豪宅. The millionaire owned a grand mansion. 百万富翁拥有一座宏伟的豪宅。 | man->停留（拉丁manere），mansion->可长久停留的地方=豪宅（cf. manor庄园，remain留下） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里的荣国府给人豪门大宅的典型印象，最适合帮助记忆 mansion，可以说 **a grand mansion — “The Jia family residence in Dream of the Red Chamber can be imagined as a grand mansion filled with courtyards, halls, and servants.”**

quiz.question: _______ dimension
quiz.explanation: 维度, 空间维度. The problem involves multiple spatial dimension. 这个问题涉及多个空间维度。 | di->两边，mens->测量，dimension->向两边测量=维度（cf. immense巨大的=无法测量的） || 文化联想：中国家庭买家具前常先拿卷尺量房间尺寸，最适合帮助记忆 dimension，可以说 **room dimensions — “Before ordering a large dining table, a homeowner should measure the room dimensions carefully.”**

quiz.question: pension ____
quiz.explanation: 养老金, 养老金基金. Workers contribute to the pension fund. 工人向养老金基金缴款。 | pens->称量/支付（拉丁pendere），pension->定期支付的钱=养老金（cf. expense费用，compensate补偿） || 文化联想：退休职工按月领取养老金的场景最适合帮助记忆 pension，可以说 **a pension fund — “Workers contribute over the years so that a pension fund can support income after retirement.”**

quiz.question: ______ pretension
quiz.explanation: 自命不凡, 社会自命不凡. Her social pretension annoyed friends. 她的社会自命不凡惹恼了朋友。 | pre->提前，tens->伸展，pretension->伸手够不到的东西=自命不凡（cf. pretend假装，tension紧张） || 文化联想：中文“装腔作势、自命不凡”最适合帮助记忆 pretension，可以说 **social pretension — “Someone who constantly drops famous names and exaggerates family status may display social pretension—‘装腔作势.’”**

quiz.question: hypertension _______
quiz.explanation: 高血压, 高血压患者. The hypertension patient takes daily medication. 高血压患者每天服药。 | hyper->过度，tens->压力，hypertension->过度压力=高血压（cf. hypotension低血压） || 文化联想：中国社区卫生中心里中老年人定期量血压最适合帮助记忆 hypertension，可以说 **a hypertension patient — “A hypertension patient may check blood pressure regularly and follow a doctor’s treatment plan.”**

quiz.question: _________ distension
quiz.explanation: 膨胀, 腹部膨胀. The doctor noted abdominal distension. 医生注意到腹部膨胀。 | dis->分开，tens->拉伸，distension->向外拉伸=膨胀（cf. distend膨胀，tension张力） || 文化联想：医院里医生观察腹部明显胀大最适合帮助记忆 distension，可以说 **abdominal distension — “A doctor may record abdominal distension when a patient’s abdomen is unusually swollen or enlarged.”**

quiz.question: ______ aversion
quiz.explanation: 厌恶, 强烈的厌恶. He developed a strong aversion to crowds. 他对人群产生了强烈的厌恶。 | a->离开，vers->转，aversion->转身离开=厌恶（cf. avert避开，adverse不利的） || 文化联想：“一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳”最适合帮助记忆 aversion，可以说 **a strong aversion — “After one frightening encounter, a person may develop a strong aversion to anything that resembles the original danger—‘一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳.’”**

quiz.question: _____ reversion
quiz.explanation: 恢复, 产权恢复. The contract stipulated title reversion. 合同规定了产权恢复。 | re->回，vers->转，reversion->转回原来=恢复/归还（cf. reverse逆转，revert恢复） || 文化联想：王朝复辟或制度重新回到旧模式的历史场景最适合帮助记忆 reversion，可以说 **a reversion to the old system — “Restoring an earlier political arrangement after a period of reform would represent a reversion to the old system.”**

quiz.question: _______ excursion
quiz.explanation: 远足, 周末远足. The family planned a weekend excursion. 家人计划了周末远足。 | ex->向外，curs->跑，excursion->跑出去=短途旅行（cf. cursor光标，course路线） || 文化联想：周末从上海去苏州或杭州短途游最适合帮助记忆 excursion，可以说 **a weekend excursion — “A family in Shanghai may take a weekend excursion to Suzhou to visit gardens and canals.”**

quiz.question: ____ compassion
quiz.explanation: 同情, 表现同情. We must show compassion for the suffering. 我们必须对受苦的人表现同情。 | com->共同，pass->受苦，compassion->与人共同受苦=同情（cf. passion激情/受难，patient病人） || 文化联想：“雪中送炭”最适合帮助记忆 compassion，可以说 **show compassion — “Helping a struggling family with food and money during a crisis is a way to show compassion—像‘雪中送炭.’”**

quiz.question: ____ cession
quiz.explanation: 割让, 土地割让. The treaty involved land cession. 条约涉及土地割让。 | cess->走/让出（拉丁cedere），cession->让出=割让（cf. recession退潮，concession让步） || 文化联想：1842年《南京条约》涉及香港岛的割让，是 cession 很清晰的历史联想，可以说 **the cession of territory — “The Treaty of Nanjing in 1842 included the cession of Hong Kong Island to Britain.”**

quiz.question: ________ recession
quiz.explanation: 衰退, 经济衰退. The country entered an economic recession. 国家进入了经济衰退。 | re->后退，cess->走，recession->向后退=经济衰退/退场（cf. recede后退，procession行进） || 文化联想：中文财经语境里的“经济衰退”最适合帮助记忆 recession，可以说 **an economic recession — “When production, investment, and employment contract for an extended period, an economy may enter an economic recession.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ concession
quiz.explanation: 让步, 做出让步. Negotiators agreed to make a concession. 谈判者同意做出让步。 | con->共同，cess->让出，concession->共同让出=让步/特许权（cf. concede承认，accede同意） || 文化联想：谈判时“各退一步”最适合帮助记忆 concession，可以说 **make a concession — “Two sides trying to settle a dispute may each make a concession—也就是‘各退一步.’”**

quiz.question: _____ digression
quiz.explanation: 离题, 短暂的离题. After a brief digression, we returned to the topic. 经过短暂的离题后,我们回到话题。 | di->分离，gress->走，digression->走偏了=离题（cf. progress进步，transgress越界） || 文化联想：中文“说着说着跑题了”最适合帮助记忆 digression，可以说 **a long digression — “A teacher discussing Tang poetry may wander into a long digression about modern television before returning to the poem.”**

quiz.question: _____ transgression
quiz.explanation: 违反, 严重的违反. The offense was a grave transgression. 该罪行是严重的违反。 | trans->越过，gress->走，transgression->越过界限=违反（cf. trespass侵犯，aggression侵略） || 文化联想：孔子所说“七十而从心所欲，不逾矩”里的“逾矩”最适合帮助记忆 transgression，可以说 **a moral transgression — “To cross a clear ethical boundary is a moral transgression—可以联想到古语中的‘逾矩.’”**

quiz.question: ________ depression
quiz.explanation: 抑郁症, 临床抑郁症. She was treated for clinical depression. 她接受了临床抑郁症的治疗。 | de->向下，press->压，depression->被压下去=抑郁/经济萧条（cf. compress压缩，suppress压制） || 文化联想：中文财经语境里的“大萧条”最适合帮助记忆 depression，可以说 **an economic depression — “A prolonged collapse in output, jobs, and investment is an economic depression—中文常译作‘经济萧条.’”**

quiz.question: _____ impression
quiz.explanation: 印象, 第一印象. First impression is often lasting. 第一印象往往持久。 | im->进入，press->压，impression->压进去留下的痕迹=印象（cf. express表达，oppress压迫） || 文化联想：中文“第一印象很重要”最适合帮助记忆 impression，可以说 **a first impression — “A neat appearance and polite greeting can create a strong first impression when meeting someone for the first time.”**

quiz.question: obsession ____
quiz.explanation: 痴迷, 痴迷于. His obsession with details slowed progress. 他对细节的痴迷减缓了进展。 | ob->在旁，sess->坐，obsession->有东西一直坐在旁边不走=痴迷（cf. possess占有，session会议） || 文化联想：中文“走火入魔”最适合帮助记忆 obsession，可以说 **an obsession with exams — “Studying every waking hour and thinking about scores constantly can turn exam preparation into an unhealthy obsession—近似‘走火入魔.’”**

quiz.question: _________ scission
quiz.explanation: 分裂, 政治分裂. The party faced political scission. 该党面临政治分裂。 | sciss->切（拉丁scindere），scission->切割=分裂（cf. scissors剪刀，rescission撤销） || 文化联想：武侠小说里一个门派因掌门继承问题分裂成两派，最适合帮助记忆 scission，可以说 **a scission within the school — “In a wuxia story, a bitter succession dispute may cause a scission within a martial-arts school.”**

quiz.question: ____ abscission
quiz.explanation: 脱落, 叶子脱落. Autumn triggers leaf abscission. 秋天触发叶子脱落。 | ab->离开，sciss->切，abscission->切断分离=脱落（植物学术语，cf. scissors剪刀） || 文化联想：秋天树叶从枝头自然脱落，是 abscission 最直观的植物学场景，可以说 **leaf abscission — “As autumn arrives, hormonal changes trigger leaf abscission and the leaves separate from the branches.”**

quiz.question: rescission ______
quiz.explanation: 撤销, 撤销通知. The company sent a rescission notice. 公司发送了撤销通知。 | re->回，sciss->切，rescission->切断退回=撤销合同（cf. recession经济衰退，scission分裂） || 文化联想：买房交易因重大问题依法解除合同的场景最适合帮助记忆 rescission，可以说 **contract rescission — “If a serious legal defect invalidates a home purchase agreement, one party may seek contract rescission.”**

quiz.question: ______ submission
quiz.explanation: 提交, 正式提交. The proposal required formal submission. 该提案需要正式提交。 | sub->在下，miss->送，submission->送到下面=提交/屈服（cf. submit提交，missile导弹） || 文化联想：中国大学生在线提交论文或申请材料最适合帮助记忆 submission，可以说 **formal submission — “A graduate student must complete the formal submission of a thesis before the university deadline.”**

quiz.question: admission ______
quiz.explanation: 入场, 入场券. Visitors must present an admission ticket. 访客必须出示入场券。 | ad->进入，miss->送，admission->被送入=入场/承认（cf. permit允许，commit承诺） || 文化联想：高考后收到大学录取通知书最适合帮助记忆 admission，可以说 **university admission — “A student who receives the long-awaited录取通知书 has finally secured university admission.”**

quiz.question: ___ remission
quiz.explanation: 减免, 税收减免. The government granted tax remission. 政府批准了税收减免。 | re->回，miss->送，remission->送回去=减免/病情缓解（cf. remit汇款，emit发射） || 文化联想：灾害发生后对受影响企业给予税费减免最适合帮助记忆 remission，可以说 **tax remission — “After a severe disaster, authorities may grant temporary tax remission to help affected businesses recover.”**

quiz.question: _____ commission
quiz.explanation: 佣金, 销售佣金. Agents earn sales commission on transactions. 代理商在交易中赚取销售佣金。 | com->共同，miss->送，commission->共同委派=委员会/佣金（cf. commit承担，omit省略） || 文化联想：直播带货按成交额给主播或平台提成的场景最适合帮助记忆 commission，可以说 **sales commission — “A livestream salesperson may earn sales commission based on the value of products sold through the broadcast.”**

quiz.question: _____ intermission
quiz.explanation: 中场休息, 电影中场休息. There was no movie intermission during the film. 电影期间没有中场休息。 | inter->中间，miss->送，intermission->中间送走观众=中场休息（cf. intermediate中间的） || 文化联想：话剧或大型舞台演出中间短暂休息最适合帮助记忆 intermission，可以说 **a theater intermission — “During a long stage production, the audience may leave their seats briefly during the theater intermission.”**

quiz.question: concussion ________
quiz.explanation: 脑震荡, 脑震荡协议. Athletes follow strict concussion protocol. 运动员遵循严格的脑震荡协议。 | con->共同，cuss->震动撞击，concussion->猛烈震动=脑震荡（cf. discuss讨论=摇动想法，percussion打击） || 文化联想：学校足球或篮球比赛撞到头后按脑震荡流程评估，最适合帮助记忆 concussion，可以说 **a concussion protocol — “After a player takes a hard blow to the head, the medical team may follow a concussion protocol before allowing a return to play.”**

quiz.question: _____ percussion
quiz.explanation: 打击乐, 小军鼓打击乐. The drummer played snare percussion. 鼓手演奏小军鼓打击乐。 | per->穿透，cuss->敲击，percussion->敲打穿透=打击乐（cf. concussion脑震荡，discuss讨论） || 文化联想：舞狮时大鼓、锣和钹组成强烈的打击乐效果，最适合帮助记忆 percussion，可以说 **Chinese percussion — “A lion-dance performance depends on Chinese percussion as drums, gongs, and cymbals drive the rhythm.”**

quiz.question: _______ fusion
quiz.explanation: 聚变, 核聚变. Scientists research nuclear fusion energy. 科学家研究核聚变能源。 | fus->倒/熔合（拉丁fundere），fusion->熔合在一起=聚变（cf. diffusion扩散，confusion混乱，infuse灌输） || 文化联想：中国媒体常把核聚变研究中的大型装置称作“人造太阳”，最适合帮助记忆 fusion，可以说 **nuclear fusion — “The popular image of an ‘artificial sun’ helps Chinese learners remember nuclear fusion as the process that powers real stars.”**

quiz.question: _______ illusion
quiz.explanation: 幻觉, 视错觉. The optical illusion made the lines appear curved. 视错觉使线条看起来是弯曲的。 | il->否定，lus->玩（拉丁ludere），illusion->被玩弄=幻觉（cf. delude欺骗，allude暗示） || 文化联想：中国古代常把“海市蜃楼”当作虚幻景象的典型，最适合帮助记忆 illusion，可以说 **an optical illusion — “A mirage over a hot road can create an optical illusion that looks like water in the distance.”**

quiz.question: ____ disillusion
quiz.explanation: 幻灭, 逐渐幻灭. Citizens began to grow disillusion with politics. 公民开始对政治逐渐幻灭。 | dis->去除，illusion->幻觉，disillusion->去除幻觉=幻灭（cf. disillusioned幻灭的） || 文化联想：中文“偶像滤镜碎了”最适合帮助记忆 disillusion，可以说 **political disillusion — “When repeated promises fail, voters may experience political disillusion and lose faith in leaders they once admired.”**

quiz.question: ________ approbation
quiz.explanation: 认可, 官方认可. The plan received official approbation. 该计划获得了官方认可。 | ap->朝向，prob->好/证明，approbation->向好的方向证明=认可（cf. approve批准，probation试用期） || 文化联想：古代奏章若得到皇帝朱批认可，就很适合帮助记忆 approbation，可以说 **official approbation — “A proposal endorsed by the highest authority has received official approbation.”**

quiz.question: ___ incubation
quiz.explanation: 孵化, 卵孵化. Egg incubation takes several weeks. 卵孵化需要几周时间。 | in->在上，cub->躺（拉丁cubare），incubation->趴在蛋上=孵化（cf. incubator孵化器，succumb倒下） || 文化联想：农村母鸡抱窝孵蛋是 incubation 最直观的画面，可以说 **egg incubation — “A brooding hen keeps the eggs warm throughout the period of egg incubation.”**

quiz.question: dedication ________
quiz.explanation: 奉献, 奉献仪式. The dedication ceremony honored volunteers. 奉献仪式向志愿者致敬。 | de->彻底，dic->说/献（拉丁），dedication->郑重宣告献出=奉献（cf. dedicate献身，dictate命令） || 文化联想：中文“十年磨一剑”最适合帮助记忆 dedication，可以说 **years of dedication — “A craftsman who spends a decade mastering one skill shows years of dedication—‘十年磨一剑.’”**

quiz.question: _____ vindication
quiz.explanation: 辩护, 法律辩护. The verdict provided legal vindication. 判决提供了法律辩护。 | vind->保护/复仇（拉丁vindicare），vindication->证明清白=辩护（cf. vindictive报复的，avenge复仇） || 文化联想：中文“沉冤得雪”最适合帮助记忆 vindication，可以说 **legal vindication — “When new evidence clears a wrongly accused person, the court’s decision can provide legal vindication—‘沉冤得雪.’”**

quiz.question: personification __ _______
quiz.explanation: 拟人化, 正义的化身. The statue is a personification of justice. 雕像是正义的化身。 | person->人，fic->制造，personification->制造成人的样子=拟人化（cf. persona人格，magnify放大） || 文化联想：包公在大众文化中常被视为公正的化身，最适合帮助记忆 personification，可以说 **the personification of justice — “Bao Zheng is often portrayed as the personification of justice because he judges rich and poor by the same standard.”**

quiz.question: ________ unification
quiz.explanation: 统一, 国家统一. The leader achieved national unification. 领导人实现了国家统一。 | uni->一，fic->制造，unification->制造成一体=统一（cf. unity团结，uniform制服） || 文化联想：秦统一六国最适合帮助记忆 unification，可以说 **national unification — “The Qin conquest of the rival states in 221 BCE brought political unification under a single imperial government.”**

quiz.question: ____ gasification
quiz.explanation: 气化, 煤气化. Coal gasification produces synthetic gas. 煤气化产生合成气。 | gas->气体，fic->制造，gasification->转化成气体=气化（cf. liquefaction液化，solidification固化） || 文化联想：中国煤化工产业很适合帮助记忆 gasification，可以说 **coal gasification — “A coal-chemical plant may use coal gasification to convert solid coal into a combustible gas mixture.”**

quiz.question: ______ ratification
quiz.explanation: 批准, 条约批准. Treaty ratification requires senate approval. 条约批准需要参议院批准。 | rat->确认（拉丁ratus->确定），fic->制造，ratification->使之确定=批准（cf. ratio比率，rational理性的） || 文化联想：现代国际条约正式生效前常需要批准程序，最适合帮助记忆 ratification，可以说 **treaty ratification — “After negotiators sign an agreement, treaty ratification may still be required before it becomes binding.”**

quiz.question: _______ gratification
quiz.explanation: 满足, 即时满足. Modern society promotes instant gratification. 现代社会提倡即时满足。 | grat->感激/愉悦，fic->制造，gratification->制造愉悦=满足（cf. grateful感激，gratuitous无偿的） || 文化联想：双十一“秒杀”带来的立刻满足感最适合帮助记忆 gratification，可以说 **instant gratification — “One-click shopping and flash sales encourage instant gratification by letting buyers satisfy an impulse immediately.”**

quiz.question: ____________ certification
quiz.explanation: 认证, 专业认证. Engineers need professional certification. 工程师需要专业认证。 | cert->确定（拉丁certus），fic->制造，certification->使确定=认证（cf. certain确定的，ascertain查明） || 文化联想：工程师、会计师等职业资格证书最适合帮助记忆 certification，可以说 **professional certification — “An engineer may pursue professional certification to demonstrate that required training and standards have been met.”**

quiz.question: ____ mortification
quiz.explanation: 羞辱, 深深的羞辱. He felt deep mortification at the mistake. 他对错误感到深深的羞辱。 | mort->死亡，fic->制造，mortification->使人如死般难堪=羞辱/苦修（cf. mortal致死的，mortgage抵押） || 文化联想：中文“当众出丑，恨不得找个地缝钻进去”最适合帮助记忆 mortification，可以说 **deep mortification — “Realizing that one has confidently given the wrong answer before a large audience can cause deep mortification.”**

quiz.question: _____ justification
quiz.explanation: 正当理由, 道德正当理由. The action lacked moral justification. 该行动缺乏道德正当理由。 | just->公正，fic->制造，justification->制造公正性=正当理由（cf. justice正义，justify证明合理） || 文化联想：中文“师出有名”最适合帮助记忆 justification，可以说 **moral justification — “The phrase ‘师出有名’ captures the idea that serious action should have a convincing moral justification.”**

quiz.question: _____ implication
quiz.explanation: 影响, 法律影响. The decision has serious legal implication. 该决定具有严重的法律影响。 | im->进入，plic->折叠，implication->折叠进去隐含的=含义/影响（cf. implicate牵连，explicit明确的） || 文化联想：合同里一个小条款可能带来很大的法律后果，最适合帮助记忆 implication，可以说 **a legal implication — “A seemingly minor clause in a housing contract may carry a serious legal implication for the buyer.”**

quiz.question: ___ application
quiz.explanation: 申请, 工作申请. She submitted her job application online. 她在线提交了工作申请。 | ap->朝向，plic->折叠/应用，application->朝向某处应用=申请/应用（cf. apply申请，applicable适用的） || 文化联想：中国大学毕业生在线投简历最适合帮助记忆 application，可以说 **a job application — “A graduate may submit a job application online with a résumé, cover letter, and supporting documents.”**

quiz.question: ______ sophistication
quiz.explanation: 老练, 社交老练.
